diff --git a/src/com/android/settings/lenos/CrashLogSettings.java b/src/com/android/settings/lenos/CrashLogSettings.java
new file mode 100644
index 0000000000000000000000000000000000000000..14d410fd6ee6fa29028cf8d1f15116c89f544797
--- /dev/null
+++ b/src/com/android/settings/lenos/CrashLogSettings.java
@@ -0,0 +1,225 @@
+/*
+ * Copyright (C) 2026 The lenOS Project
+ *
+ * Licensed under the Apache License, Version 2.0 (the "License");
+ * you may not use this file except in compliance with the License.
+ * You may obtain a copy of the License at
+ *
+ *      http://www.apache.org/licenses/LICENSE-2.0
+ *
+ * Unless required by applicable law or agreed to in writing, software
+ * distributed under the License is distributed on an "AS IS" BASIS,
+ * WITHOUT WARRANTIES OR CONDITIONS OF ANY KIND, either express or implied.
+ * See the License for the specific language governing permissions and
+ * limitations under the License.
+ */
+
+package com.android.settings.lenos;
+
+import android.app.AlertDialog;
+import android.app.settings.SettingsEnums;
+import android.content.Context;
+import android.content.Intent;
+import android.os.Bundle;
+import android.os.DropBoxManager;
+import android.text.TextUtils;
+import android.text.format.DateUtils;
+import android.util.Log;
+import android.widget.TextView;
+
+import androidx.preference.Preference;
+import androidx.preference.PreferenceScreen;
+
+import com.android.settings.R;
+import com.android.settings.SettingsPreferenceFragment;
+
+import java.io.ByteArrayOutputStream;
+import java.io.IOException;
+import java.io.InputStream;
+import java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets;
+import java.util.ArrayList;
+import java.util.Comparator;
+import java.util.List;
+
+/**
+ * Local, user-initiated crash/ANR log viewer.
+ *
+ * <p>This is intentionally not a crash reporter: it never uploads anything. It reads the
+ * existing {@link DropBoxManager} records on the device, shows them newest-first, and lets the
+ * user share one entry with an app of their choice. The feature is a lenOS implementation of
+ * Tier 2 #17; it is experimental until it has been built and exercised on a device.
+ */
+public class CrashLogSettings extends SettingsPreferenceFragment {
+    private static final String TAG = "CrashLogSettings";
+
+    // DropBox tags written by ActivityManager, system_server and the native crash handler.
+    private static final String[] DROPBOX_TAGS = {
+            "system_app_crash",
+            "system_app_anr",
+            "data_app_crash",
+            "data_app_anr",
+            "system_server_crash",
+            "system_server_native_crash",
+            "system_server_watchdog",
+            "SYSTEM_TOMBSTONE",
+            "SYSTEM_RESTART",
+            "SYSTEM_BOOT",
+    };
+
+    private static final int MAX_ENTRIES = 100;
+    private static final int MAX_TEXT_BYTES = 64 * 1024;
+
+    @Override
+    public void onCreatePreferences(Bundle savedInstanceState, String rootKey) {
+        buildScreen();
+    }
+
+    private void buildScreen() {
+        final Context context = requireContext();
+        final PreferenceScreen screen = getPreferenceManager().createPreferenceScreen(context);
+
+        final Preference refresh = new Preference(context);
+        refresh.setTitle(R.string.lenos_crash_logs_refresh);
+        refresh.setSummary(R.string.lenos_crash_logs_summary);
+        refresh.setOnPreferenceClickListener(preference -> {
+            buildScreen();
+            return true;
+        });
+        screen.addPreference(refresh);
+
+        final List<LogEntry> entries = collectEntries(context);
+        if (entries.isEmpty()) {
+            final Preference empty = new Preference(context);
+            empty.setTitle(R.string.lenos_crash_logs_empty);
+            empty.setSelectable(false);
+            screen.addPreference(empty);
+        } else {
+            for (LogEntry entry : entries) {
+                final Preference preference = new Preference(context);
+                preference.setTitle(entry.tag);
+                preference.setSummary(entry.summary(context));
+                preference.setOnPreferenceClickListener(p -> {
+                    showEntry(context, entry);
+                    return true;
+                });
+                screen.addPreference(preference);
+            }
+        }
+
+        setPreferenceScreen(screen);
+    }
+
+    private static List<LogEntry> collectEntries(Context context) {
+        final DropBoxManager dropBox = context.getSystemService(DropBoxManager.class);
+        final List<LogEntry> entries = new ArrayList<>();
+        if (dropBox == null) {
+            return entries;
+        }
+
+        for (String tag : DROPBOX_TAGS) {
+            DropBoxManager.Entry entry = null;
+            try {
+                while ((entry = dropBox.getNextEntry(tag, 0)) != null) {
+                    final String text = readEntry(entry);
+                    if (!TextUtils.isEmpty(text)) {
+                        entries.add(new LogEntry(entry.getTag(), entry.getTimeMillis(), text));
+                    }
+                    entry.close();
+                    entry = null;
+                    if (entries.size() >= MAX_ENTRIES * 2) {
+                        break;
+                    }
+                }
+            } catch (RuntimeException e) {
+                Log.w(TAG, "Unable to read DropBox tag " + tag, e);
+            } finally {
+                if (entry != null) {
+                    entry.close();
+                }
+            }
+        }
+
+        entries.sort(Comparator.comparingLong((LogEntry e) -> e.timeMillis).reversed());
+        if (entries.size() > MAX_ENTRIES) {
+            return new ArrayList<>(entries.subList(0, MAX_ENTRIES));
+        }
+        return entries;
+    }
+
+    private static String readEntry(DropBoxManager.Entry entry) {
+        final String text = entry.getText(MAX_TEXT_BYTES);
+        if (text != null) {
+            return text;
+        }
+
+        // Tombstones and some native records are binary. Keep a bounded, printable preview
+        // rather than dumping arbitrary bytes into a share intent.
+        try (InputStream in = entry.getInputStream()) {
+            if (in == null) {
+                return null;
+            }
+            final ByteArrayOutputStream out = new ByteArrayOutputStream();
+            final byte[] buffer = new byte[4096];
+            int total = 0;
+            int read;
+            while (total < MAX_TEXT_BYTES && (read = in.read(buffer)) != -1) {
+                out.write(buffer, 0, read);
+                total += read;
+            }
+            return out.toString(StandardCharsets.UTF_8.name());
+        } catch (IOException e) {
+            Log.w(TAG, "Unable to read DropBox entry " + entry.getTag(), e);
+            return null;
+        }
+    }
+
+    private void showEntry(Context context, LogEntry entry) {
+        final AlertDialog dialog = new AlertDialog.Builder(context)
+                .setTitle(entry.tag)
+                .setMessage(entry.text)
+                .setPositiveButton(R.string.lenos_crash_logs_share,
+                        (d, which) -> shareEntry(context, entry))
+                .setNegativeButton(android.R.string.cancel, null)
+                .create();
+        dialog.show();
+
+        // Keep the dialog usable for long stack traces.
+        final TextView message = dialog.findViewById(android.R.id.message);
+        if (message != null) {
+            message.setTextIsSelectable(true);
+        }
+    }
+
+    private void shareEntry(Context context, LogEntry entry) {
+        final Intent send = new Intent(Intent.ACTION_SEND);
+        send.setType("text/plain");
+        send.putExtra(Intent.EXTRA_SUBJECT, "lenOS " + entry.tag);
+        send.putExtra(Intent.EXTRA_TEXT, entry.text);
+        startActivity(Intent.createChooser(send, getString(R.string.lenos_crash_logs_share_title)));
+    }
+
+    @Override
+    public int getMetricsCategory() {
+        return SettingsEnums.ABOUT_LEGAL_SETTINGS;
+    }
+
+    private static final class LogEntry {
+        final String tag;
+        final long timeMillis;
+        final String text;
+
+        LogEntry(String tag, long timeMillis, String text) {
+            this.tag = tag;
+            this.timeMillis = timeMillis;
+            this.text = text;
+        }
+
+        String summary(Context context) {
+            final String time = DateUtils.formatDateTime(context, timeMillis,
+                    DateUtils.FORMAT_SHOW_DATE | DateUtils.FORMAT_SHOW_TIME
+                            | DateUtils.FORMAT_ABBREV_MONTH);
+            final String firstLine = text.split("\\r?\\n", 2)[0];
+            return time + " · " + firstLine;
+        }
+    }
+}

diff --git a/src/com/android/settings/security/UsbPortSecuritySettings.java b/src/com/android/settings/security/UsbPortSecuritySettings.java
new file mode 100644
index 0000000000000000000000000000000000000000..404868a6676bde5dd82eee8f73355d5ef7f7c0a5

@@ -0,0 +1,155 @@
+/*
+ * Copyright (C) 2026 The lenOS Project
+ *
+ * Licensed under the Apache License, Version 2.0 (the "License");
+ * you may not use this file except in compliance with the License.
+ * You may obtain a copy of the License at
+ *
+ *      http://www.apache.org/licenses/LICENSE-2.0
+ *
+ * Unless required by applicable law or agreed to in writing, software
+ * distributed under the License is distributed on an "AS IS" BASIS,
+ * WITHOUT WARRANTIES OR CONDITIONS OF ANY KIND, either express or implied.
+ * See the License for the specific language governing permissions and
+ * limitations under the License.
+ */
+
+package com.android.settings.security;
+
+import android.app.AlertDialog;
+import android.app.settings.SettingsEnums;
+import android.hardware.usb.UsbManager;
+import android.hardware.usb.UsbPortSecurity;
+import android.os.Bundle;
+import android.widget.Toast;
+
+import androidx.preference.ListPreference;
+import androidx.preference.Preference;
+import androidx.preference.PreferenceScreen;
+
+import com.android.settings.R;
+import com.android.settings.SettingsPreferenceFragment;
+
+/**
+ * Controls whether USB data lines are available while the device is locked.
+ *
+ * <p>Uses the standard Android USB HAL data-signal operation. This is an
+ * experimental lenOS feature; the device must have a USB HAL that implements
+ * {@code enableUsbData} for the policy to take effect.</p>
+ */
+public class UsbPortSecuritySettings extends SettingsPreferenceFragment {
+    private static final String KEY = "usb_port_security";
+
+    private UsbManager mUsbManager;
+    private ListPreference mPreference;
+
+    @Override
+    public void onCreatePreferences(Bundle savedInstanceState, String rootKey) {
+        mUsbManager = requireContext().getSystemService(UsbManager.class);
+        if (mUsbManager == null) {
+            return;
+        }
+
+        mPreference = new ListPreference(requireContext());
+        mPreference.setKey(KEY);
+        mPreference.setPersistent(false);
+        mPreference.setTitle(R.string.usb_port_security_title);
+        mPreference.setDialogTitle(R.string.usb_port_security_title);
+        mPreference.setEntries(new CharSequence[]{
+                getString(R.string.usb_port_security_mode_block_all),
+                getString(R.string.usb_port_security_mode_charging_only),
+                getString(R.string.usb_port_security_mode_when_locked),
+                getString(R.string.usb_port_security_mode_when_locked_afu),
+                getString(R.string.usb_port_security_mode_enabled),
+        });
+        mPreference.setEntryValues(new CharSequence[]{
+                String.valueOf(UsbPortSecurity.MODE_ALL_PORTS_DISABLED),
+                String.valueOf(UsbPortSecurity.MODE_CHARGING_ONLY),
+                String.valueOf(UsbPortSecurity.MODE_CHARGING_ONLY_WHEN_LOCKED),
+                String.valueOf(UsbPortSecurity.MODE_CHARGING_ONLY_WHEN_LOCKED_AFU),
+                String.valueOf(UsbPortSecurity.MODE_ALL_PORTS_ENABLED),
+        });
+        mPreference.setOnPreferenceChangeListener(this::onPreferenceChange);
+
+        final PreferenceScreen screen = getPreferenceManager().createPreferenceScreen(requireContext());
+        screen.addPreference(mPreference);
+        setPreferenceScreen(screen);
+
+        if (mUsbManager.getPorts().isEmpty()) {
+            mPreference.setEnabled(false);
+            mPreference.setSummary(R.string.usb_port_security_unsupported);
+        } else {
+            updatePreference();
+        }
+    }
+
+    @Override
+    public void onResume() {
+        super.onResume();
+        if (mPreference != null && mPreference.isEnabled()) {
+            updatePreference();
+        }
+    }
+
+    private boolean onPreferenceChange(Preference preference, Object newValue) {
+        final int value;
+        try {
+            value = Integer.parseInt((String) newValue);
+        } catch (NumberFormatException e) {
+            return false;
+        }
+
+        if (value == UsbPortSecurity.MODE_ALL_PORTS_ENABLED) {
+            new AlertDialog.Builder(requireContext())
+                    .setTitle(R.string.usb_port_security_confirm_title)
+                    .setMessage(R.string.usb_port_security_confirm_message)
+                    .setPositiveButton(R.string.usb_port_security_confirm_enable,
+                            (dialog, which) -> applyMode(value))
+                    .setNegativeButton(android.R.string.cancel, null)
+                    .show();
+            return false;
+        }
+        return applyMode(value);
+    }
+
+    private boolean applyMode(int value) {
+        try {
+            mUsbManager.updatePortSecuritySetting(value);
+            updatePreference();
+            return true;
+        } catch (RuntimeException e) {
+            Toast.makeText(requireContext(), R.string.usb_port_security_error,
+                    Toast.LENGTH_LONG).show();
+            updatePreference();
+            return false;
+        }
+    }
+
+    private void updatePreference() {
+        final int mode = mUsbManager.getPortSecuritySetting();
+        mPreference.setValue(String.valueOf(mode));
+        mPreference.setSummary(entrySummary(mode));
+    }
+
+    private CharSequence entrySummary(int mode) {
+        switch (mode) {
+            case UsbPortSecurity.MODE_ALL_PORTS_DISABLED:
+                return getString(R.string.usb_port_security_mode_block_all_summary);
+            case UsbPortSecurity.MODE_CHARGING_ONLY:
+                return getString(R.string.usb_port_security_mode_charging_only_summary);
+            case UsbPortSecurity.MODE_CHARGING_ONLY_WHEN_LOCKED:
+                return getString(R.string.usb_port_security_mode_when_locked_summary);
+            case UsbPortSecurity.MODE_CHARGING_ONLY_WHEN_LOCKED_AFU:
+                return getString(R.string.usb_port_security_mode_when_locked_afu_summary);
+            case UsbPortSecurity.MODE_ALL_PORTS_ENABLED:
+                return getString(R.string.usb_port_security_mode_enabled_summary);
+            default:
+                return getString(R.string.usb_port_security_error);
+        }
+    }
+
+    @Override
+    public int getMetricsCategory() {
+        return SettingsEnums.SECURITY;
+    }
+}

+/*
+ * Copyright (C) 2026 The lenOS Project
+ *
+ * Licensed under the Apache License, Version 2.0 (the "License");
+ * you may not use this file except in compliance with the License.
+ * You may obtain a copy of the License at

+ *
+ * Unless required by applicable law or agreed to in writing, software
+ * distributed under the License is distributed on an "AS IS" BASIS,
+ * WITHOUT WARRANTIES OR CONDITIONS OF ANY KIND, either express or implied.
+ * See the License for the specific language governing permissions and
+ * limitations under the License.
+ */
+
+package com.android.settings.security;
+
+import android.app.settings.SettingsEnums;
+import android.os.Bundle;
+import android.provider.Settings;
+
+import androidx.preference.PreferenceScreen;
+import androidx.preference.SwitchPreference;
+
+import com.android.settings.R;
+import com.android.settings.SettingsPreferenceFragment;
+
+/**
+ * lenOS OPSEC control: wipe the clipboard when the screen turns off.
+ *
+ * <p>The framework side is ClipboardService. The preference is off by default
+ * because deleting a user's clipboard without warning would be surprising;
+ * users who handle secrets can opt in.</p>
+ */
+public class ClipboardPrivacySettings extends SettingsPreferenceFragment {
+    private static final String KEY_CLEAR_ON_SCREEN_OFF = "clipboard_clear_on_screen_off";
+
+    @Override
+    public void onCreatePreferences(Bundle savedInstanceState, String rootKey) {
+        final SwitchPreference preference = new SwitchPreference(requireContext());
+        preference.setKey(KEY_CLEAR_ON_SCREEN_OFF);
+        preference.setTitle(R.string.clipboard_clear_on_screen_off_title);
+        preference.setSummary(R.string.clipboard_clear_on_screen_off_summary);
+        preference.setChecked(Settings.Secure.getInt(requireContext().getContentResolver(),
+                Settings.Secure.CLIPBOARD_CLEAR_ON_SCREEN_OFF, 0) == 1);
+        preference.setOnPreferenceChangeListener((pref, newValue) -> {
+            final boolean enabled = (Boolean) newValue;
+            Settings.Secure.putInt(requireContext().getContentResolver(),
+                    Settings.Secure.CLIPBOARD_CLEAR_ON_SCREEN_OFF, enabled ? 1 : 0);
+            return true;
+        });
+
+        final PreferenceScreen screen = getPreferenceManager().createPreferenceScreen(
+                requireContext());
+        screen.addPreference(preference);
+        setPreferenceScreen(screen);
+    }
+
+    @Override
+    public int getMetricsCategory() {
+        return SettingsEnums.SECURITY;
+    }
+}

diff --git a/src/com/android/settings/security/ClipboardAppAccessSettings.java b/src/com/android/settings/security/ClipboardAppAccessSettings.java
new file mode 100644
index 0000000000000000000000000000000000000000..4e35c2295a041f3c3b4f49caa2b3e400929c7f81
--- /dev/null
+++ b/src/com/android/settings/security/ClipboardAppAccessSettings.java
@@ -0,0 +1,200 @@
+/*
+ * Copyright (C) 2026 The lenOS Project
+ *
+ * Licensed under the Apache License, Version 2.0 (the "License");
+ * you may not use this file except in compliance with the License.
+ * You may obtain a copy of the License at
+ *
+ *      http://www.apache.org/licenses/LICENSE-2.0
+ *
+ * Unless required by applicable law or agreed to in writing, software
+ * distributed under the License is distributed on an "AS IS" BASIS,
+ * WITHOUT WARRANTIES OR CONDITIONS OF ANY KIND, either express or implied.
+ * See the License for the specific language governing permissions and
+ * limitations under the License.
+ */
+
+package com.android.settings.security;
+
+import android.app.AppOpsManager;
+import android.app.settings.SettingsEnums;
+import android.content.Context;
+import android.content.pm.ApplicationInfo;
+import android.content.pm.PackageManager;
+import android.graphics.drawable.Drawable;
+import android.os.Bundle;
+import android.os.Handler;
+import android.os.Looper;
+import android.view.inputmethod.InputMethodInfo;
+import android.view.inputmethod.InputMethodManager;
+import android.widget.Toast;
+
+import androidx.preference.Preference;
+import androidx.preference.PreferenceScreen;
+import androidx.preference.SwitchPreference;
+
+import com.android.settings.R;
+import com.android.settings.SettingsPreferenceFragment;
+
+import java.util.ArrayList;
+import java.util.Comparator;
+import java.util.HashSet;
+import java.util.List;
+import java.util.Set;
+import java.util.concurrent.ExecutorService;
+import java.util.concurrent.Executors;
+
+/**
+ * lenOS Secure Paste stage 2: per-app clipboard read control.
+ *
+ * <p>Android already has {@link AppOpsManager#OP_READ_CLIPBOARD}; the default mode is
+ * allowed. This screen flips individual user-installed apps to
+ * {@link AppOpsManager#MODE_IGNORED}, which the clipboard service checks after its
+ * focus/system-service exemptions. It deliberately lists only user-installed apps:
+ * system apps and enabled keyboards are part of the trusted paste path, and hiding
+ * them avoids a one-tap way to break keyboard paste.</p>
+ *
+ * <p>This is a Settings-only feature. It does not add a framework patch, a new
+ * permission or a new app-op; it exposes the existing AppOps policy. It composes
+ * with the global Secure Paste default: a global block still wins, and a per-app
+ * allow cannot override it unless that framework policy is changed.</p>
+ */
+public class ClipboardAppAccessSettings extends SettingsPreferenceFragment {
+    private final ExecutorService mExecutor = Executors.newSingleThreadExecutor();
+    private final Handler mMainHandler = new Handler(Looper.getMainLooper());
+
+    private AppOpsManager mAppOps;
+    private PreferenceScreen mScreen;
+
+    @Override
+    public void onCreatePreferences(Bundle savedInstanceState, String rootKey) {
+        final Context context = requireContext();
+        mAppOps = context.getSystemService(AppOpsManager.class);
+        mScreen = getPreferenceManager().createPreferenceScreen(context);
+        setPreferenceScreen(mScreen);
+
+        final Preference loading = new Preference(context);
+        loading.setTitle(R.string.clipboard_app_access_loading);
+        loading.setSelectable(false);
+        mScreen.addPreference(loading);
+
+        final Preference note = new Preference(context);
+        note.setTitle(R.string.clipboard_app_access_note);
+        note.setSelectable(false);
+        mScreen.addPreference(note);
+
+        mExecutor.execute(() -> {
+            final List<AppEntry> apps = loadUserApps(context);
+            mMainHandler.post(() -> {
+                if (!isAdded()) {
+                    return;
+                }
+                mScreen.removePreference(loading);
+                for (AppEntry app : apps) {
+                    mScreen.addPreference(createSwitch(context, app));
+                }
+                if (apps.isEmpty()) {
+                    final Preference empty = new Preference(context);
+                    empty.setTitle(R.string.clipboard_app_access_empty);
+                    empty.setSelectable(false);
+                    mScreen.addPreference(empty);
+                }
+            });
+        });
+    }
+
+    private List<AppEntry> loadUserApps(Context context) {
+        final PackageManager pm = context.getPackageManager();
+        final List<ApplicationInfo> installed = pm.getInstalledApplications(0);
+        final HashSet<String> imePackages = enabledImePackages(context);
+        final ArrayList<AppEntry> result = new ArrayList<>();
+        for (ApplicationInfo info : installed) {
+            if ((info.flags & ApplicationInfo.FLAG_SYSTEM) != 0
+                    || (info.flags & ApplicationInfo.FLAG_UPDATED_SYSTEM_APP) != 0
+                    || !info.enabled
+                    || imePackages.contains(info.packageName)) {
+                continue;
+            }
+            final String label = info.loadLabel(pm).toString();
+            final Drawable icon = info.loadIcon(pm);
+            final String[] shared = pm.getPackagesForUid(info.uid);
+            result.add(new AppEntry(info.packageName, info.uid, label, icon,
+                    shared != null && shared.length > 1));
+        }
+        result.sort(Comparator.comparing(entry -> entry.label, String.CASE_INSENSITIVE_ORDER));
+        return result;
+    }
+
+    private static HashSet<String> enabledImePackages(Context context) {
+        final HashSet<String> packages = new HashSet<>();
+        final InputMethodManager imm = context.getSystemService(InputMethodManager.class);
+        if (imm != null) {
+            for (InputMethodInfo ime : imm.getEnabledInputMethodList()) {
+                packages.add(ime.getPackageName());
+            }
+        }
+        return packages;
+    }
+
+    private SwitchPreference createSwitch(Context context, AppEntry app) {
+        final SwitchPreference preference = new SwitchPreference(context);
+        preference.setKey(app.packageName + "/" + app.uid);
+        preference.setTitle(app.label);
+        preference.setSummary(app.sharedUid
+                ? context.getString(R.string.clipboard_app_access_shared, app.packageName)
+                : app.packageName);
+        preference.setIcon(app.icon);
+        preference.setChecked(currentlyAllowed(app));
+        preference.setOnPreferenceChangeListener((pref, newValue) -> {
+            final boolean allow = (Boolean) newValue;
+            try {
+                mAppOps.setMode(AppOpsManager.OP_READ_CLIPBOARD, app.uid, app.packageName,
+                        allow ? AppOpsManager.MODE_ALLOWED : AppOpsManager.MODE_IGNORED);
+                // setMode returns silently when package verification fails; do not
+                // leave the switch in a state the service is not enforcing.
+                return currentlyAllowed(app) == allow;
+            } catch (SecurityException e) {
+                Toast.makeText(context, R.string.clipboard_app_access_failed,
+                        Toast.LENGTH_LONG).show();
+                return false;
+            }
+        });
+        return preference;
+    }
+
+    private boolean currentlyAllowed(AppEntry app) {
+        try {
+            return mAppOps.unsafeCheckOpNoThrow(AppOpsManager.OPSTR_READ_CLIPBOARD, app.uid,
+                    app.packageName) != AppOpsManager.MODE_IGNORED;
+        } catch (SecurityException e) {
+            return false;
+        }
+    }
+
+    @Override
+    public int getMetricsCategory() {
+        return SettingsEnums.SECURITY;
+    }
+
+    @Override
+    public void onDestroy() {
+        super.onDestroy();
+        mExecutor.shutdownNow();
+    }
+
+    private static final class AppEntry {
+        final String packageName;
+        final int uid;
+        final String label;
+        final Drawable icon;
+        final boolean sharedUid;
+
+        AppEntry(String packageName, int uid, String label, Drawable icon, boolean sharedUid) {
+            this.packageName = packageName;
+            this.uid = uid;
+            this.label = label;
+            this.icon = icon;
+            this.sharedUid = sharedUid;
+        }
+    }
+}

diff --git a/src/com/android/settings/security/NativeDebuggingBlockSettings.java b/src/com/android/settings/security/NativeDebuggingBlockSettings.java
new file mode 100644
index 0000000000000000000000000000000000000000..716c96a2265cd89a6ddefd83d8c4f0ccfe49dfed
--- /dev/null
+++ b/src/com/android/settings/security/NativeDebuggingBlockSettings.java
@@ -0,0 +1,60 @@
+/*
+ * Copyright (C) 2026 The lenOS Project
+ *
+ * Licensed under the Apache License, Version 2.0 (the "License");
+ * you may not use this file except in compliance with the License.
+ * You may obtain a copy of the License at
+ *
+ *      http://www.apache.org/licenses/LICENSE-2.0
+ *
+ * Unless required by applicable law or agreed to in writing, software
+ * distributed under the License is distributed on an "AS IS" BASIS,
+ * WITHOUT WARRANTIES OR CONDITIONS OF ANY KIND, either express or implied.
+ * See the License for the specific language governing permissions and
+ * limitations under the License.
+ */
+
+package com.android.settings.security;
+
+import android.app.settings.SettingsEnums;
+import android.os.Bundle;
+import android.provider.Settings;
+
+import androidx.preference.SwitchPreference;
+
+import com.android.settings.R;
+import com.android.settings.SettingsPreferenceFragment;
+
+/**
+ * Experimental global native-debugging block.
+ *
+ * <p>This is deliberately not GrapheneOS's per-app native-debugging screen. It controls one
+ * secure setting that {@code ActivityThread} reads for newly started app processes. The kernel
+ * clear-dumpable policy is applied only to non-system, non-debuggable and non-profileable apps.
+ * Running processes keep their current dumpable state until they are restarted.</p>
+ */
+public class NativeDebuggingBlockSettings extends SettingsPreferenceFragment {
+    private SwitchPreference mBlock;
+
+    @Override
+    public void onCreatePreferences(Bundle savedInstanceState, String rootKey) {
+        addPreferencesFromResource(R.xml.native_debugging_block);
+        mBlock = findPreference(Settings.Secure.BLOCK_NATIVE_DEBUGGING);
+        if (mBlock == null) {
+            return;
+        }
+        mBlock.setChecked(Settings.Secure.getInt(getContentResolver(),
+                Settings.Secure.BLOCK_NATIVE_DEBUGGING, 0) == 1);
+        mBlock.setOnPreferenceChangeListener((preference, newValue) -> {
+            final boolean enabled = (Boolean) newValue;
+            Settings.Secure.putInt(getContentResolver(),
+                    Settings.Secure.BLOCK_NATIVE_DEBUGGING, enabled ? 1 : 0);
+            return true;
+        });
+    }
+
+    @Override
+    public int getMetricsCategory() {
+        return SettingsEnums.SECURITY;
+    }
+}

====================================================================================================
diff --git a/AndroidProducts.mk b/AndroidProducts.mk
index f204e05..966e2c4 100644
--- a/AndroidProducts.mk
+++ b/AndroidProducts.mk
@@ -4,4 +4,5 @@
 #
 
 PRODUCT_MAKEFILES := \
-    $(LOCAL_DIR)/lineage_asteroids.mk
+    $(LOCAL_DIR)/lineage_asteroids.mk \
+    $(LOCAL_DIR)/lenos_asteroids.mk
diff --git a/lenos_asteroids.mk b/lenos_asteroids.mk
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..dd95d1f
--- /dev/null
+++ b/lenos_asteroids.mk
@@ -0,0 +1,38 @@
+#
+# SPDX-FileCopyrightText: 2026 lenOS
+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+#
+# lenOS product for the Nothing Phone (3a) / (3a) Pro (asteroids).
+#
+# Inherits the LineageOS device configuration and layers the lenOS product
+# configuration (vendor/lenos/config/lenos.mk) on top: bundled apps, product
+# overlays, first-boot defaults and hardening properties.
+#
+# The build fingerprint and the device identity are deliberately left at the
+# stock values: changing them breaks app compatibility, SafetyNet/Play
+# Integrity style checks and Nothing's factory tooling. Everything lenOS adds
+# is namespaced under ro.lenos.* and in the lenOS settings UI.
+#
+# LENOS_STRIP_PACKAGES is read by vendor/lineage/config/*.mk (patched) and must
+# be set here, in the product makefile itself: the inherited app lists are
+# evaluated after this file, but product makefiles cannot filter inherited
+# PRODUCT_PACKAGES values. Same for TARGET_EXCLUDES_AUDIOFX, an existing
+# LineageOS switch.
+
+# Apps dropped from the build (sources stay in the tree). Gallery2 is kept out
+# in favour of Glimpse; the browser (Jelly) is kept for now, see
+# vendor/lenos/docs/features.md.
+LENOS_STRIP_PACKAGES := \
+    Gallery2
+
+# LineageOS' existing switch for AudioFX (bass boost / equalizer).
+TARGET_EXCLUDES_AUDIOFX := true
+
+$(call inherit-product, device/nothing/asteroids/lineage_asteroids.mk)
+$(call inherit-product, vendor/lenos/config/lenos.mk)
+
+PRODUCT_NAME := lenos_asteroids
+PRODUCT_DEVICE := asteroids
+
+PRODUCT_SYSTEM_EXT_PROPERTIES += \
+    ro.lenos.product=lenos_asteroids

diff --git a/services/core/java/com/android/server/policy/keyguard/AutoReboot.java b/services/core/java/com/android/server/policy/keyguard/AutoReboot.java
new file mode 100644
index 0000000000000000000000000000000000000000..7bbff53d39f516bd06aaabbbd7fdb351abe66f54
--- /dev/null
+++ b/services/core/java/com/android/server/policy/keyguard/AutoReboot.java
@@ -0,0 +1,56 @@
+/*
+ * Copyright (C) 2023 GrapheneOS
+ * Copyright (C) 2026 The lenOS Project
+ *
+ * Licensed under the Apache License, Version 2.0 (the "License");
+ * you may not use this file except in compliance with the License.

+ *

+ * Unless required by applicable law or agreed to in writing, software
+ * distributed under the License is distributed on an "AS IS" BASIS,
+ * WITHOUT WARRANTIES OR CONDITIONS OF ANY KIND, either express or implied.
+ * See the License for the specific language governing permissions and
+ * limitations under the License.
+ */
+
+package com.android.server.policy.keyguard;
+
+import android.content.Context;
+import android.ext.settings.ExtSettings;
+import android.os.SystemProperties;
+import android.util.Slog;
+
+/** @hide */
+class AutoReboot {
+    private static final String TAG = AutoReboot.class.getSimpleName();
+
+    // writes to this system property are special-cased in init
+    private static final String SYS_PROP = "sys.auto_reboot_ctl";
+
+    // This callback is invoked:
+    // - when keyguard becomes active (i.e. when device gets locked, including at boot-time)
+    // - when keyguard is dismissed by unlocking the device
+    // - when keyguard is dismissed by switching to a user that doesn't have a secure lockscreen,
+    // but not when switching to a user that does have a secure lockscreen
+    // - showing=false callback is invoked at boot-time when there's no lock screen, i.e. when the
+    // device boots straight into the home screen or initial setup wizard
+    //
+    // Note that "swipe-to-unlock" lockscreen is considered to be a keyguard.
+    static void onKeyguardShowingStateChanged(Context ctx, boolean showing, int userId) {
+        Slog.d(TAG, "onKeyguardShowingStateChanged, showing: " + showing + ", userId: " + userId);
+
+        if (!showing) {
+            SystemProperties.set(SYS_PROP, "on_device_unlocked");
+            return;
+        }
+
+        final int timeoutMillis = ExtSettings.AUTO_REBOOT_TIMEOUT.get(ctx);
+        final int timeoutSeconds = timeoutMillis / 1000;
+        if (timeoutSeconds > 0) {
+            SystemProperties.set(SYS_PROP, Integer.toString(timeoutSeconds));
+        }
+        Slog.d(TAG, "timeoutSeconds: " + timeoutSeconds);
+    }
+}

+
+    // lenOS: duress credentials (see LockSettingsService.DuressPasswordHelper).
+    // Entering either credential at a credential prompt destroys the storage
+    // keys and powers the device off.
+
+    /**
+     * lenOS: duress credentials must be at least 4 characters/digits with the
+     * lowest complexity requirements.
+     */
+    public static List<PasswordValidationError> validateDuressCredential(
+            @NonNull LockscreenCredential credential) {
+        PasswordMetrics metrics = new PasswordMetrics(credential.getType());
+        metrics.length = 4;
+        return PasswordMetrics.validateCredential(metrics,
+                DevicePolicyManager.PASSWORD_COMPLEXITY_LOW, credential);
+    }
+
+    /**
+     * lenOS: sets the duress credentials; requires the current owner
+     * credential. Passing "none" for both deletes them.
+     */
+    public void setDuressCredentials(@NonNull LockscreenCredential ownerCredential,
+            @NonNull LockscreenCredential duressPin,
+            @NonNull LockscreenCredential duressPassword) {
+        try {
+            getLockSettings().setDuressCredentials(ownerCredential, duressPin, duressPassword);
+        } catch (RemoteException e) {
+            throw e.rethrowFromSystemServer();
+        }
+    }
+
+    /** lenOS: deletes the duress credentials; requires the owner credential. */
+    public void deleteDuressCredentials(@NonNull LockscreenCredential ownerCredential) {
+        LockscreenCredential noCredential = LockscreenCredential.createNone();
+        try {
+            getLockSettings().setDuressCredentials(ownerCredential, noCredential, noCredential);
+        } catch (RemoteException e) {
+            throw e.rethrowFromSystemServer();
+        }
+    }
+
+    /** lenOS: whether duress credentials are set; requires the owner credential. */
+    public boolean hasDuressCredentials(@NonNull LockscreenCredential ownerCredential) {
+        try {
+            return getLockSettings().hasDuressCredentials(ownerCredential);
+        } catch (RemoteException e) {
+            throw e.rethrowFromSystemServer();
+        }
+    }
 }
diff --git a/services/core/java/com/android/server/locksettings/DuressCredential.java b/services/core/java/com/android/server/locksettings/DuressCredential.java
new file mode 100644
index 0000000000000000000000000000000000000000..e5c992bdadf7986c14ac44d30ab24058e0f335c6
--- /dev/null
+++ b/services/core/java/com/android/server/locksettings/DuressCredential.java
@@ -0,0 +1,91 @@
+/*
+ * Copyright (C) 2024 GrapheneOS
+ * Copyright (C) 2026 The lenOS Project
+ *
+ * Licensed under the Apache License, Version 2.0 (the "License");
+ * you may not use this file except in compliance with the License.
+ * You may obtain a copy of the License at
+ *
+ *      http://www.apache.org/licenses/LICENSE-2.0
+ *
+ * Unless required by applicable law or agreed to in writing, software
+ * distributed under the License is distributed on an "AS IS" BASIS,
+ * WITHOUT WARRANTIES OR CONDITIONS OF ANY KIND, either express or implied.
+ * See the License for the specific language governing permissions and
+ * limitations under the License.
+ */
+
+package com.android.server.locksettings;
+
+import com.android.internal.widget.LockPatternUtils;
+import com.android.internal.widget.LockscreenCredential;
+import com.android.internal.widget.PasswordValidationError;
+import com.android.server.locksettings.SyntheticPasswordManager.PasswordData;
+
+import java.io.DataInputStream;
+import java.io.DataOutputStream;
+import java.io.IOException;
+import java.util.Arrays;
+import java.util.List;
+
+/**
+ * lenOS: one stored duress credential (port of GrapheneOS's implementation).
+ *
+ * <p>Only a scrypt-stretched hash of the credential is stored (the same
+ * synthetic-password stretching the real lock credential uses), so the stored
+ * form cannot be replayed at a credential prompt.
+ */
+final class DuressCredential {
+    private final PasswordData mSalt;
+    private final byte[] mHashedCredential;
+
+    DuressCredential(PasswordData salt, byte[] hashedCredential) {
+        mSalt = salt;
+        mHashedCredential = hashedCredential;
+    }
+
+    static DuressCredential create(LockscreenCredential credential, SyntheticPasswordManager spm) {
+        PasswordData salt = PasswordData.create(credential.getType(),
+                // no need to leak PIN length here, it's used only for PIN auto-confirm
+                LockPatternUtils.PIN_LENGTH_UNAVAILABLE);
+        byte[] hashedCredential = spm.stretchLskf(credential, salt);
+        return new DuressCredential(salt, hashedCredential);
+    }
+
+    boolean verify(SyntheticPasswordManager spm, LockscreenCredential credential) {
+        return Arrays.equals(mHashedCredential, spm.stretchLskf(credential, mSalt));
+    }
+
+    int getType() {
+        return mSalt.credentialType;
+    }
+
+    void serialize(DataOutputStream s) throws IOException {
+        byte[] saltBytes = mSalt.toBytes();
+        s.writeInt(saltBytes.length);
+        s.write(saltBytes);
+        s.writeInt(mHashedCredential.length);
+        s.write(mHashedCredential);
+    }
+
+    static DuressCredential deserialize(DataInputStream s) throws IOException {
+        PasswordData salt = PasswordData.fromBytes(s.readNBytes(s.readInt()));
+        byte[] hashedCredential = s.readNBytes(s.readInt());
+        return new DuressCredential(salt, hashedCredential);
+    }
+
+    static void validate(LockscreenCredential credential, int expectedType) {
+        int type = credential.getType();
+        if (type != expectedType) {
+            throw new IllegalArgumentException("type mismatch: expected " + expectedType
+                    + ", got " + type);
+        }
+
+        List<PasswordValidationError> validationErrors =
+                LockPatternUtils.validateDuressCredential(credential);
+        if (!validationErrors.isEmpty()) {
+            throw new IllegalArgumentException("validation failed: "
+                    + Arrays.toString(validationErrors.toArray()));
+        }
+    }
+}
diff --git a/services/core/java/com/android/server/locksettings/DuressCredentials.java b/services/core/java/com/android/server/locksettings/DuressCredentials.java
new file mode 100644
index 0000000000000000000000000000000000000000..e09cd475ae43b3f5a7d97b3b0b592e1759fdd795
--- /dev/null
+++ b/services/core/java/com/android/server/locksettings/DuressCredentials.java
@@ -0,0 +1,131 @@
+/*
+ * Copyright (C) 2024 GrapheneOS
+ * Copyright (C) 2026 The lenOS Project
+ *
+ * Licensed under the Apache License, Version 2.0 (the "License");
+ * you may not use this file except in compliance with the License.
+ * You may obtain a copy of the License at
+ *
+ *      http://www.apache.org/licenses/LICENSE-2.0
+ *
+ * Unless required by applicable law or agreed to in writing, software
+ * distributed under the License is distributed on an "AS IS" BASIS,
+ * WITHOUT WARRANTIES OR CONDITIONS OF ANY KIND, either express or implied.
+ * See the License for the specific language governing permissions and
+ * limitations under the License.
+ */
+
+package com.android.server.locksettings;
+
+import android.annotation.Nullable;
+import android.os.UserHandle;
+
+import com.android.internal.widget.LockscreenCredential;
+
+import java.io.ByteArrayInputStream;
+import java.io.ByteArrayOutputStream;
+import java.io.DataInputStream;
+import java.io.DataOutputStream;
+import java.io.IOException;
+
+import libcore.util.HexEncoding;
+
+import static com.android.internal.widget.LockPatternUtils.CREDENTIAL_TYPE_PASSWORD;
+import static com.android.internal.widget.LockPatternUtils.CREDENTIAL_TYPE_PIN;
+
+/**
+ * lenOS: the stored duress credential pair (port of GrapheneOS's
+ * implementation). A duress PIN and a duress password are kept side by side;
+ * either one can be set to "none".
+ *
+ * <p>Serialized as hex in the system user's lock settings storage
+ * ({@code locksettings.db}).
+ */
+final class DuressCredentials {
+    final DuressCredential pin;
+    final DuressCredential password;
+
+    DuressCredentials(DuressCredential pin, DuressCredential password) {
+        if (pin.getType() != CREDENTIAL_TYPE_PIN) {
+            throw new IllegalArgumentException();
+        }
+        this.pin = pin;
+        if (password.getType() != CREDENTIAL_TYPE_PASSWORD) {
+            throw new IllegalArgumentException();
+        }
+        this.password = password;
+    }
+
+    static DuressCredentials create(SyntheticPasswordManager spm,
+            LockscreenCredential pin, LockscreenCredential password) {
+        return new DuressCredentials(DuressCredential.create(pin, spm),
+                DuressCredential.create(password, spm));
+    }
+
+    private static final String LOCK_SETTINGS_STORAGE_KEY = "duress_credentials";
+    private static final int LOCK_SETTINGS_STORAGE_USER_ID = UserHandle.USER_SYSTEM;
+
+    void save(LockSettingsStorage lss) {
+        lss.setString(LOCK_SETTINGS_STORAGE_KEY, serialize(), LOCK_SETTINGS_STORAGE_USER_ID);
+    }
+
+    @Nullable
+    static DuressCredentials maybeGet(LockSettingsStorage lss) {
+        String s = lss.getString(LOCK_SETTINGS_STORAGE_KEY, null, LOCK_SETTINGS_STORAGE_USER_ID);
+        if (s == null) {
+            return null;
+        }
+        return deserialize(s);
+    }
+
+    static void delete(LockSettingsStorage lss) {
+        lss.removeKey(LOCK_SETTINGS_STORAGE_KEY, LOCK_SETTINGS_STORAGE_USER_ID);
+    }
+
+    DuressCredential get(int type) {
+        switch (type) {
+            case CREDENTIAL_TYPE_PIN:
+                return pin;
+            case CREDENTIAL_TYPE_PASSWORD:
+                return password;
+            default:
+                throw new IllegalArgumentException(Integer.toString(type));
+        }
+    }
+
+    private static final int VERSION = 0;
+
+    private String serialize() {
+        ByteArrayOutputStream bos = new ByteArrayOutputStream(1000);
+        DataOutputStream s = new DataOutputStream(bos);
+        try {
+            s.writeByte(VERSION);
+            pin.serialize(s);
+            password.serialize(s);
+        } catch (IOException e) {
+            // ByteArrayOutputStream never throws IOException
+            throw new IllegalStateException(e);
+        }
+
+        return HexEncoding.encodeToString(bos.toByteArray());
+    }
+
+    private static DuressCredentials deserialize(String str) {
+        DataInputStream s = new DataInputStream(new ByteArrayInputStream(HexEncoding.decode(str)));
+        try {
+            int version = s.readByte();
+            if (version > VERSION) {
+                throw new IllegalArgumentException(str);
+            }
+            DuressCredential pin = DuressCredential.deserialize(s);
+            DuressCredential password = DuressCredential.deserialize(s);
+            if (s.available() != 0) {
+                throw new IllegalArgumentException(str);
+            }
+            return new DuressCredentials(pin, password);
+        } catch (IOException e) {
+            // ByteArrayInputStream never throws IOException
+            throw new IllegalStateException(e);
+        }
+    }
+}
diff --git a/services/core/java/com/android/server/locksettings/DuressPasswordHelper.java b/services/core/java/com/android/server/locksettings/DuressPasswordHelper.java
new file mode 100644
index 0000000000000000000000000000000000000000..2c32540565b0323e32d08ea71ed1a73e9e9e86e6
--- /dev/null
+++ b/services/core/java/com/android/server/locksettings/DuressPasswordHelper.java
@@ -0,0 +1,144 @@
+/*
+ * Copyright (C) 2024 GrapheneOS
+ * Copyright (C) 2026 The lenOS Project
+ *
+ * Licensed under the Apache License, Version 2.0 (the "License");
+ * you may not use this file except in compliance with the License.
+ * You may obtain a copy of the License at
+ *
+ *      http://www.apache.org/licenses/LICENSE-2.0
+ *
+ * Unless required by applicable law or agreed to in writing, software
+ * distributed under the License is distributed on an "AS IS" BASIS,
+ * WITHOUT WARRANTIES OR CONDITIONS OF ANY KIND, either express or implied.
+ * See the License for the specific language governing permissions and
+ * limitations under the License.
+ */
+
+package com.android.server.locksettings;
+
+import android.annotation.Nullable;
+import android.os.HandlerThread;
+import android.os.UserHandle;
+import android.util.Slog;
+
+import com.android.internal.widget.LockscreenCredential;
+import com.android.internal.widget.VerifyCredentialResponse;
+
+import java.util.Objects;
+
+import static com.android.internal.widget.LockPatternUtils.CREDENTIAL_TYPE_NONE;
+import static com.android.internal.widget.LockPatternUtils.CREDENTIAL_TYPE_PASSWORD;
+import static com.android.internal.widget.LockPatternUtils.CREDENTIAL_TYPE_PIN;
+
+/**
+ * lenOS: manages the duress credential pair and detects it at credential
+ * verification time (port of GrapheneOS's implementation).
+ *
+ * <p>Every failed credential verification is checked against the stored duress
+ * credentials on a background thread; a match destroys the storage keys and
+ * powers the device off ({@link DuressWipe}). Successful verifications are
+ * ignored, so the normal lock credential can never trigger the wipe.
+ */
+final class DuressPasswordHelper {
+    private static final String TAG = DuressPasswordHelper.class.getSimpleName();
+
+    private final LockSettingsService mLockSettingsService;
+    private final LockSettingsStorage mLockSettingsStorage;
+    private final SyntheticPasswordManager mSpManager;
+    private final HandlerThread mBackgroundThread;
+
+    DuressPasswordHelper(LockSettingsService lockSettingsService,
+            LockSettingsStorage lockSettingsStorage, SyntheticPasswordManager spManager) {
+        HandlerThread bgThread = new HandlerThread("DuressPasswordHelper");
+        bgThread.start();
+        mBackgroundThread = bgThread;
+        mLockSettingsService = lockSettingsService;
+        mLockSettingsStorage = lockSettingsStorage;
+        mSpManager = spManager;
+    }
+
+    void onVerifyCredentialResult(@Nullable VerifyCredentialResponse res,
+            @Nullable LockscreenCredential credential) {
+        if (res != null && res.isMatched()) {
+            return;
+        }
+
+        if (credential == null) {
+            return;
+        }
+
+        // original credential is zeroized after this method returns
+        LockscreenCredential credentialCopy = credential.duplicate();
+
+        // credential verification is slow, don't block the current (usually binder) thread
+        mBackgroundThread.getThreadHandler().post(() -> {
+            final boolean isDuressCredential;
+            try {
+                isDuressCredential = isDuressCredential(credentialCopy);
+            } finally {
+                // invalid credential might be similar to the actual credential
+                credentialCopy.zeroize();
+            }
+            if (isDuressCredential) {
+                DuressWipe.run(mLockSettingsService.getContext());
+            }
+        });
+    }
+
+    private void checkOwnerCredential(LockscreenCredential ownerCredential) {
+        int userId = UserHandle.USER_SYSTEM;
+
+        if (mLockSettingsService.getCredentialType(userId) == CREDENTIAL_TYPE_NONE) {
+            if (!ownerCredential.isNone()) {
+                throw new IllegalArgumentException("!ownerCredential.isNone()");
+            }
+        } else {
+            VerifyCredentialResponse response = mLockSettingsService.checkCredential(ownerCredential,
+                    userId, null);
+
+            if (!response.isMatched()) {
+                throw new SecurityException("owner credential verification failed; " + response);
+            }
+        }
+    }
+
+    void setDuressCredentials(LockscreenCredential ownerCredential,
+            LockscreenCredential pin, LockscreenCredential password) {
+        Objects.requireNonNull(ownerCredential, "ownerCredential");
+        Objects.requireNonNull(pin, "pin");
+        Objects.requireNonNull(password, "password");
+
+        checkOwnerCredential(ownerCredential);
+
+        if (pin.isNone() && password.isNone()) {
+            // exception handling is delegated to the caller
+            DuressCredentials.delete(mLockSettingsStorage);
+            Slog.d(TAG, "deleted duress credentials");
+            return;
+        }
+
+        DuressCredential.validate(pin, CREDENTIAL_TYPE_PIN);
+        DuressCredential.validate(password, CREDENTIAL_TYPE_PASSWORD);
+
+        // exception handling is delegated to the caller
+        DuressCredentials.create(mSpManager, pin, password).save(mLockSettingsStorage);
+    }
+
+    boolean hasDuressCredentials(LockscreenCredential ownerCredential) {
+        checkOwnerCredential(ownerCredential);
+        return DuressCredentials.maybeGet(mLockSettingsStorage) != null;
+    }
+
+    private boolean isDuressCredential(LockscreenCredential credential) {
+        int credentialType = credential.getType();
+        switch (credentialType) {
+            case CREDENTIAL_TYPE_PIN:
+            case CREDENTIAL_TYPE_PASSWORD:
+                DuressCredentials dc = DuressCredentials.maybeGet(mLockSettingsStorage);
+                return dc != null && dc.get(credentialType).verify(mSpManager, credential);
+            default:
+                return false;
+        }
+    }
+}
diff --git a/services/core/java/com/android/server/locksettings/DuressWipe.java b/services/core/java/com/android/server/locksettings/DuressWipe.java
new file mode 100644
index 0000000000000000000000000000000000000000..d09289cb04fc40d76e51e7ad3bb61829b8bb173c
--- /dev/null
+++ b/services/core/java/com/android/server/locksettings/DuressWipe.java
@@ -0,0 +1,109 @@
+/*
+ * Copyright (C) 2024 GrapheneOS
+ * Copyright (C) 2026 The lenOS Project
+ *
+ * Licensed under the Apache License, Version 2.0 (the "License");
+ * you may not use this file except in compliance with the License.
+ * You may obtain a copy of the License at
+ *
+ *      http://www.apache.org/licenses/LICENSE-2.0
+ *
+ * Unless required by applicable law or agreed to in writing, software
+ * distributed under the License is distributed on an "AS IS" BASIS,
+ * WITHOUT WARRANTIES OR CONDITIONS OF ANY KIND, either express or implied.
+ * See the License for the specific language governing permissions and
+ * limitations under the License.
+ */
+
+package com.android.server.locksettings;
+
+import android.annotation.UptimeMillisLong;
+import android.content.Context;
+import android.os.SystemClock;
+import android.telephony.euicc.EuiccCardManager;
+import android.util.Slog;
+
+import com.android.internal.telephony.euicc.EuiccWipe;
+import com.android.server.power.PowerManagerService;
+import com.android.server.recoverysystem.RecoverySystemService;
+
+/**
+ * lenOS: erases the eSIM profiles, destroys the storage keys and powers the
+ * device off (port of GrapheneOS's implementation). Reached only when a duress
+ * credential is entered at a credential prompt; there is no way back, the user
+ * data becomes cryptographically inaccessible.
+ *
+ * <p>The eUICC memory reset runs on its own thread and gets a short head start
+ * before the key deletion. The cryptographic erase is what makes the data
+ * inaccessible and never waits for the eUICC, so a missing or unresponsive
+ * eUICC can delay the power-off by at most three seconds.
+ */
+final class DuressWipe {
+    private static final String TAG = DuressWipe.class.getSimpleName();
+
+    // Test hook, set by `cmd lock_settings set-duress-credentials
+    // --sleep-5s-before-poweroff`: delays the power-off so the wipe can be
+    // observed. Never set by the UI.
+    static boolean sleep5sBeforePoweroff;
+
+    private DuressWipe() {}
+
+    static void run(Context context) {
+        Slog.d(TAG, "start");
+
+        EuiccWipeThread euiccWipeThread = EuiccWipeThread.start(context);
+
+        Slog.d(TAG, "calling deleteSecrets");
+        // deleteSecrets() calls AndroidKeyStoreMaintenance.deleteAllKeys(), which deletes all
+        // KeyMint keys, including the storage encryption keys, and wipes Secretkeeper.
+        RecoverySystemService.deleteSecrets();
+        Slog.d(TAG, "deleteSecrets returned");
+
+        euiccWipeThread.await(3000);
+        Slog.d(TAG, "finished waiting for euiccWipeThread");
+
+        if (sleep5sBeforePoweroff) {
+            SystemClock.sleep(5000);
+        }
+
+        PowerManagerService.lowLevelShutdown(null);
+    }
+
+    static class EuiccWipeThread extends Thread {
+        private final Context context;
+        @UptimeMillisLong private long startTime;
+
+        private EuiccWipeThread(Context context) {
+            this.context = context;
+        }
+
+        static EuiccWipeThread start(Context ctx) {
+            var t = new EuiccWipeThread(ctx);
+            t.start();
+            t.startTime = SystemClock.uptimeMillis();
+            return t;
+        }
+
+        @Override
+        public void run() {
+            try {
+                EuiccWipe.run(context, EuiccCardManager.RESET_FLAG_IS_FOR_DURESS_WIPE);
+            } catch (Throwable e) {
+                Slog.e(TAG, "", e);
+            }
+        }
+
+        void await(long timeoutMs) {
+            long remaining = timeoutMs - (SystemClock.uptimeMillis() - startTime);
+            if (remaining <= 0) {
+                return;
+            }
+            try {
+                join(remaining);
+            } catch (InterruptedException e) {
+                // should never happen, but don't rethrow it just in case
+                Slog.e(TAG, "", e);
+            }
+        }
+    }
+}

+    // deletes the pair), --sleep-5s-before-poweroff (test hook). Entering
+    // either duress credential at a credential prompt destroys the storage
+    // keys and powers off.
+    private int handleSetDuressCredentials() {
+        LockscreenCredential pin = null;
+        LockscreenCredential password = null;
+        boolean sleep5sBeforePoweroff = false;
+
+        for (;;) {
+            String opt = getNextOption();
+            if (opt == null) {
+                break;
+            }
+
+            switch (opt) {
+                case "--old":
+                    mOld = getNextArgRequired();
+                    break;
+                case "--duress-pin":
+                    String pinStr = getNextArgRequired();
+                    if (pinStr.isEmpty()) {
+                        pin = LockscreenCredential.createNone();
+                    } else {
+                        pin = LockscreenCredential.createPin(pinStr);
+                    }
+                    break;
+                case "--duress-password":
+                    String pwdStr = getNextArgRequired();
+                    if (pwdStr.isEmpty()) {
+                        password = LockscreenCredential.createNone();
+                    } else {
+                        password = LockscreenCredential.createPassword(pwdStr);
+                    }
+                    break;
+                case "--sleep-5s-before-poweroff":
+                    sleep5sBeforePoweroff = true;
+                    break;
+                default:
+                    getErrPrintWriter().println("unknown option " + opt);
+                    return -1;
+            }
+        }
+
+        if (getRemainingArgsCount() != 0) {
+            getErrPrintWriter().println("unknown arg: " + getNextArg());
+            return -1;
+        }
+        if (pin == null) {
+            getErrPrintWriter().println("missing --duress-pin value");
+            return -1;
+        }
+        if (password == null) {
+            getErrPrintWriter().println("missing --duress-password value");
+            return -1;
+        }
+
+        mCurrentUserId = UserHandle.USER_SYSTEM;
+        if (!checkCredential()) {
+            return -1;
+        }
+
+        try {
+            mLockPatternUtils.setDuressCredentials(getOldCredential(), pin, password);
+        } finally {
+            pin.zeroize();
+            password.zeroize();
+        }
+        DuressWipe.sleep5sBeforePoweroff = sleep5sBeforePoweroff;
+        return 0;
+    }
+
     private void runVerify() {
         // The command is only run if the credential is correct.
         getOutPrintWriter().println("Lock credential verified successfully");

diff --git a/core/java/android/ext/settings/BoolSetting.java b/core/java/android/ext/settings/BoolSetting.java
new file mode 100644
index 0000000000000000000000000000000000000000..006f404c7d5d9d43e501ca255f656fa1d1ea1994
--- /dev/null
+++ b/core/java/android/ext/settings/BoolSetting.java
@@ -0,0 +1,88 @@
+/*

+ * Copyright (C) 2026 The lenOS Project

+ * distributed under the License is distributed on an "AS IS" BASIS,
+ * WITHOUT WARRANTIES OR CONDITIONS OF ANY KIND, either express or implied.
+ * See the License for the specific language governing permissions and
+ * limitations under the License.
+ */
+
+package android.ext.settings;
+
+import android.annotation.NonNull;
+import android.annotation.SystemApi;
+import android.content.Context;
+
+import java.util.function.Function;
+
+/** @hide */
+@SystemApi
+public class BoolSetting extends Setting<BoolSetting> {
+    private boolean defaultValue;
+    private volatile Function<Context, Boolean> defaultValueSupplier;
+
+    public BoolSetting(@NonNull Scope scope, @NonNull String key, boolean defaultValue) {
+        super(scope, key);
+        this.defaultValue = defaultValue;
+    }
+
+    public BoolSetting(@NonNull Scope scope, @NonNull String key, @NonNull Function<Context, Boolean> defaultValue) {
+        super(scope, key);
+        defaultValueSupplier = defaultValue;
+    }
+
+    public final boolean get(@NonNull Context ctx) {
+        return get(ctx, ctx.getUserId());
+    }
+
+    // use only if this is a per-user setting and the context is not a per-user one
+    public final boolean get(@NonNull Context ctx, int userId) {
+        String valueStr = getRaw(ctx, userId);
+
+        if (valueStr == null) {
+            return getDefaultValue(ctx);
+        }
+
+        if (valueStr.equals("true")) {
+            return true;
+        }
+
+        if (valueStr.equals("false")) {
+            return false;
+        }
+
+        try {
+            int valueInt = Integer.parseInt(valueStr);
+            if (valueInt == 1) {
+                return true;
+            } else if (valueInt == 0) {
+                return false;
+            }
+        } catch (NumberFormatException e) {
+            e.printStackTrace();
+        }
+
+        return getDefaultValue(ctx);
+    }
+
+    public final boolean put(@NonNull Context ctx, boolean val) {
+        return putRaw(ctx, val ? "1" : "0");
+    }
+
+    private boolean getDefaultValue(Context ctx) {
+        Function<Context, Boolean> supplier = defaultValueSupplier;
+        if (supplier != null) {
+            defaultValue = supplier.apply(ctx).booleanValue();
+            defaultValueSupplier = null;
+        }
+        return defaultValue;
+    }
+}

+/*

+
+package android.ext.settings;
+
+import android.annotation.BoolRes;
+import android.annotation.IntegerRes;
+import android.annotation.StringRes;
+import android.content.Context;
+import android.provider.Settings;
+
+import com.android.internal.R;
+
+import java.util.concurrent.TimeUnit;
+import java.util.function.Function;
+import java.util.function.ToIntFunction;
+
+/**
+ * Note that android.provider.Settings setting names should be defined in the corresponding classes,
+ * since the readability of settings is determined by using Java reflection on members of that class.
+ *
+ * @see android.provider.Settings#getPublicSettingsForClass
+ * @hide
+ */
+public class ExtSettings {
+
+    public static final BoolSysProperty EXEC_SPAWNING = new BoolSysProperty(
+            "persist.security.exec_spawn", true);
+
+    public static final BoolSetting ALLOW_KEYGUARD_CAMERA = new BoolSetting(
+            Setting.Scope.SYSTEM_PROPERTY, "persist.keyguard.camera", true);
+
+    public static final BoolSetting AUTO_GRANT_OTHER_SENSORS_PERMISSION = new BoolSetting(
+            Setting.Scope.PER_USER, Settings.Secure.AUTO_GRANT_OTHER_SENSORS_PERMISSION, true);
+
+    public static final IntSetting AUTO_REBOOT_TIMEOUT = new IntSetting(
+            Setting.Scope.GLOBAL, Settings.Global.AUTO_REBOOT_TIMEOUT,
+            // default value: 18 hours
+            (int) TimeUnit.HOURS.toMillis(18));
+
+    public static final BoolSetting SCREENSHOT_TIMESTAMP_EXIF = new BoolSetting(
+            Setting.Scope.PER_USER, Settings.Secure.SCREENSHOT_TIMESTAMP_EXIF, false);
+
+    public static final BoolSetting SCRAMBLE_LOCKSCREEN_PIN_LAYOUT_PRIMARY = new BoolSetting(
+            Setting.Scope.PER_USER, Settings.Secure.SCRAMBLE_PIN_LAYOUT_PRIMARY,
+            // lenOS: scrambled PIN layout is on by default (hardening deviation from
+            // GrapheneOS, which ships this toggle disabled). The SIM PIN layout inherits
+            // this value.
+            true);
+    public static final BoolSetting SCRAMBLE_LOCKSCREEN_PIN_LAYOUT_SECONDARY = new BoolSetting(
+            Setting.Scope.PER_USER, Settings.Secure.SCRAMBLE_PIN_LAYOUT_SECONDARY, false);
+
+    public static final BoolSetting SCRAMBLE_SIM_PIN_LAYOUT = new BoolSetting(
+            Setting.Scope.PER_USER, Settings.Secure.SCRAMBLE_SIM_PIN_LAYOUT,
+            // inherit lockscreen PIN setting by default
+            SCRAMBLE_LOCKSCREEN_PIN_LAYOUT_PRIMARY::get);
+
+    public static final BoolSysProperty ALLOW_GOOGLE_APPS_SPECIAL_ACCESS_TO_ACCELERATORS = new BoolSysProperty(
+            // also accessed in native code, in frameworks/native/cmds/servicemanager/Access.cpp
+            "persist.sys.allow_google_apps_special_access_to_accelerators", true);
+
+    // The amount of time in milliseconds before a disconnected Wi-Fi adapter is turned off
+    public static final IntSetting WIFI_AUTO_OFF = new IntSetting(
+            Setting.Scope.GLOBAL, Settings.Global.WIFI_AUTO_OFF, 0 /* off by default */);
+
+    // The amount of time in milliseconds before a disconnected Bluetooth adapter is turned off
+    public static final IntSetting BLUETOOTH_AUTO_OFF = new IntSetting(
+            Setting.Scope.GLOBAL, Settings.Global.BLUETOOTH_AUTO_OFF, 0 /* off by default */);
+
+    // The amount of time in milliseconds before a Nfc adapter is turned off
+    public static final IntSetting NFC_AUTO_OFF = new IntSetting(
+            Setting.Scope.GLOBAL, Settings.Global.NFC_AUTO_OFF, 0 /* off by default */);
+
+    public static final BoolSysProperty ALLOW_NATIVE_DEBUG_BY_DEFAULT = new BoolSysProperty(
+            "persist.native_debug", defaultBool(R.bool.setting_default_allow_native_debugging));
+
+    // AppCompatConfig specifies which hardening features are compatible/incompatible with a
+    // specific app.
+    // This setting controls whether incompatible hardening features would be disabled by default
+    // for that app. In both cases, user will still be able to enable/disable them manually.
+    //
+    // Note that hardening features that are marked as compatible are enabled unconditionally by
+    // default, regardless of this setting.
+    public static final BoolSetting ALLOW_DISABLING_HARDENING_VIA_APP_COMPAT_CONFIG = new BoolSetting(
+            Setting.Scope.GLOBAL, Settings.Global.ALLOW_DISABLING_HARDENING_VIA_APP_COMPAT_CONFIG,
+            defaultBool(R.bool.setting_default_allow_disabling_hardening_via_app_compat_config));
+
+    public static final BoolSetting RESTRICT_MEMORY_DYN_CODE_LOADING_BY_DEFAULT = new BoolSetting(
+            Setting.Scope.GLOBAL, Settings.Global.RESTRICT_MEMORY_DYN_CODE_LOADING_BY_DEFAULT,
+            defaultBool(R.bool.setting_default_restrict_memory_dyn_code_loading));
+
+    public static final BoolSetting RESTRICT_STORAGE_DYN_CODE_LOADING_BY_DEFAULT = new BoolSetting(
+            Setting.Scope.GLOBAL, Settings.Global.RESTRICT_STORAGE_DYN_CODE_LOADING_BY_DEFAULT,
+            defaultBool(R.bool.setting_default_restrict_storage_dyn_code_loading));
+
+    public static final BoolSetting RESTRICT_WEBVIEW_DYN_CODE_LOADING_BY_DEFAULT = new BoolSetting(
+            Setting.Scope.GLOBAL, Settings.Global.RESTRICT_WEBVIEW_DYN_CODE_LOADING_BY_DEFAULT,
+            defaultBool(R.bool.setting_default_restrict_webview_dyn_code_loading));
+
+    public static final BoolSetting FORCE_APP_MEMTAG_BY_DEFAULT = new BoolSetting(
+            Setting.Scope.GLOBAL, Settings.Global.FORCE_APP_MEMTAG_BY_DEFAULT,
+            defaultBool(R.bool.setting_default_force_app_memtag));
+
+    public static final BoolSetting SHOW_SYSTEM_PROCESS_CRASH_NOTIFICATIONS = new BoolSetting(
+            Setting.Scope.GLOBAL, Settings.Global.SHOW_SYSTEM_PROCESS_CRASH_NOTIFICATIONS, false);
+
+    public static final BoolSetting DISALLOW_DELAYED_LOCKING_ON_USER_STOP = new BoolSetting(
+            Setting.Scope.PER_USER, Settings.Secure.DISALLOW_DELAYED_LOCKING_ON_USER_STOP, false);
+
+    public static final BoolSetting ALLOW_CLIPBOARD_READ_BY_DEFAULT = new BoolSetting(
+            Setting.Scope.GLOBAL, Settings.Global.ALLOW_CLIPBOARD_READ_BY_DEFAULT,
+            defaultBool(R.bool.setting_default_allow_clipboard_read));
+
+    private ExtSettings() {}
+
+    public static Function<Context, Boolean> defaultBool(@BoolRes int res) {
+        return ctx -> ctx.getResources().getBoolean(res);
+    }
+
+    public static ToIntFunction<Context> defaultInt(@IntegerRes int res) {
+        return ctx -> ctx.getResources().getInteger(res);
+    }
+
+    public static Function<Context, String> defaultString(@StringRes int res) {
+        return ctx -> ctx.getString(res);
+    }
+}

+ * limitations under the License.

+
+package android.ext.settings;
+
+import android.content.Context;
+import android.provider.Settings;
+
+/**
+ * GNSS network-assistance privacy settings, ported from GrapheneOS
+ * {@code core/java/android/ext/settings/GnssSettings.java}.
+ *
+ * <p>GrapheneOS adds two extra modes that route SUPL and PSDS through its own
+ * proxies. lenOS has no such proxy infrastructure, so only the standard and
+ * disabled modes are offered. The setting keys and numeric values match
+ * GrapheneOS, so the proxy modes can be added later without a data
+ * migration.</p>
+ *
+ * <p>Both settings default to disabled: the device never contacts a SUPL or
+ * PSDS server unless the user explicitly turns the standard server back on.
+ * Disabling them makes a location fix slower (especially the first one) but
+ * avoids sending the device's IP address and cell-derived location to a
+ * third-party assistance server.</p>
+ *
+ * @hide
+ */
+public class GnssSettings {
+
+    // Values match GrapheneOS. SUPL mode 2 (GrapheneOS proxy) is reserved but
+    // not offered by lenOS.
+    public static final int SUPL_SERVER_STANDARD = 0;
+    public static final int SUPL_DISABLED = 1;
+
+    public static final IntSetting SUPL_SETTING = new IntSetting(
+            Setting.Scope.GLOBAL, Settings.Global.GNSS_SUPL,
+            SUPL_DISABLED, // lenOS: disabled by default (GrapheneOS: proxy)
+            SUPL_SERVER_STANDARD, SUPL_DISABLED // valid values
+    );
+
+    // Keep in sync with bionic/libc/bionic/gnss_psds_setting.c in GrapheneOS.
+    public static final int PSDS_SERVER_GRAPHENEOS = 0; // reserved, not offered
+    public static final int PSDS_SERVER_STANDARD = 1;
+    public static final int PSDS_DISABLED = 2;
+
+    public static final IntSetting STANDARD_PSDS_SETTING = new IntSetting(
+            Setting.Scope.GLOBAL, Settings.Global.GNSS_PSDS_STANDARD,
+            PSDS_DISABLED, // lenOS: disabled by default (GrapheneOS: their server)
+            PSDS_SERVER_STANDARD, PSDS_DISABLED // valid values
+    );
+
+    public static IntSetting getPsdsSetting(Context ctx) {
+        return STANDARD_PSDS_SETTING;
+    }
+
+    public static boolean isStandardPsds(Context ctx) {
+        return getPsdsSetting(ctx) == STANDARD_PSDS_SETTING;
+    }
+}
diff --git a/core/java/android/ext/settings/IntSetting.java b/core/java/android/ext/settings/IntSetting.java
new file mode 100644
index 0000000000000000000000000000000000000000..b027ba4b2e5541e0d2ff454e886ab7d9580db279
--- /dev/null
+++ b/core/java/android/ext/settings/IntSetting.java
@@ -0,0 +1,123 @@
+/*
+ * Copyright (C) 2022 GrapheneOS
+ * Copyright (C) 2026 The lenOS Project
+ *
+ * Licensed under the Apache License, Version 2.0 (the "License");
+ * you may not use this file except in compliance with the License.
+ * You may obtain a copy of the License at
+ *
+ *      http://www.apache.org/licenses/LICENSE-2.0
+ *
+ * Unless required by applicable law or agreed to in writing, software
+ * distributed under the License is distributed on an "AS IS" BASIS,
+ * WITHOUT WARRANTIES OR CONDITIONS OF ANY KIND, either express or implied.
+ * See the License for the specific language governing permissions and
+ * limitations under the License.
+ */
+
+package android.ext.settings;
+
+import android.annotation.NonNull;
+import android.annotation.Nullable;
+import android.annotation.SystemApi;
+import android.content.Context;
+
+import java.util.function.ToIntFunction;
+
+/** @hide */
+@SystemApi
+public class IntSetting extends Setting<IntSetting> {
+    private int defaultValue;
+    private volatile ToIntFunction<Context> defaultValueSupplier;
+
+    @Nullable private final int[] validValues;
+
+    private IntSetting(@NonNull Scope scope, @NonNull String key, @Nullable int[] validValues) {
+        super(scope, key);
+        this.validValues = validValues;
+    }
+
+    public IntSetting(@NonNull Scope scope, @NonNull String key, int defaultValue) {
+        this(scope, key, (int[]) null);
+        setDefaultValue(defaultValue);
+    }
+
+    public IntSetting(@NonNull Scope scope, @NonNull String key, int defaultValue, @NonNull int... validValues) {
+        this(scope, key, validValues);
+        setDefaultValue(defaultValue);
+    }
+
+    public IntSetting(@NonNull Scope scope, @NonNull String key, @NonNull ToIntFunction<Context> defaultValue) {
+        this(scope, key, (int[]) null);
+        defaultValueSupplier = defaultValue;
+    }
+
+    public IntSetting(@NonNull Scope scope, @NonNull String key, @NonNull ToIntFunction<Context> defaultValue,
+                      @NonNull int... validValues) {
+        this(scope, key, validValues);
+        defaultValueSupplier = defaultValue;
+    }
+
+    public boolean validateValue(int val) {
+        if (validValues == null) {
+            return true;
+        }
+        // don't do sort() + bsearch() of validValues array, it's expected to have a small number of entries
+        for (int validValue : validValues) {
+            if (val == validValue) {
+                return true;
+            }
+        }
+        return false;
+    }
+
+    public final int get(@NonNull Context ctx) {
+        return get(ctx, ctx.getUserId());
+    }
+
+    // use only if this is a per-user setting and the context is not a per-user one
+    public final int get(@NonNull Context ctx, int userId) {
+        String valueStr = getRaw(ctx, userId);
+
+        if (valueStr == null) {
+            return getDefaultValue(ctx);
+        }
+
+        int value;
+        try {
+            value = Integer.parseInt(valueStr);
+        } catch (NumberFormatException e) {
+            e.printStackTrace();
+            return getDefaultValue(ctx);
+        }
+
+        if (!validateValue(value)) {
+            return getDefaultValue(ctx);
+        }
+
+        return value;
+    }
+
+    public final boolean put(@NonNull Context ctx, int val) {
+        if (!validateValue(val)) {
+            throw new IllegalArgumentException(Integer.toString(val));
+        }
+        return putRaw(ctx, Integer.toString(val));
+    }
+
+    private void setDefaultValue(int val) {
+        if (!validateValue(val)) {
+            throw new IllegalStateException("invalid default value " + val);
+        }
+        defaultValue = val;
+    }
+
+    private int getDefaultValue(Context ctx) {
+        ToIntFunction<Context> supplier = defaultValueSupplier;
+        if (supplier != null) {
+            setDefaultValue(supplier.applyAsInt(ctx));
+            defaultValueSupplier = null;
+        }
+        return defaultValue;
+    }
+}

diff --git a/core/java/android/ext/settings/Setting.java b/core/java/android/ext/settings/Setting.java
new file mode 100644
index 0000000000000000000000000000000000000000..17c8a12184d4ab90bb9e3b03d1d2bc0a058aad3c
--- /dev/null
+++ b/core/java/android/ext/settings/Setting.java
@@ -0,0 +1,191 @@
+/*

+ * Copyright (C) 2026 The lenOS Project
+ *
+ * Licensed under the Apache License, Version 2.0 (the "License");
+ * you may not use this file except in compliance with the License.
