class TestQsUnlockGating(LenosPatchTest):
    PROJECT = "frameworks/base"
    PATCHES = ["0004-lenos-qs-unlock-gating.patch"]
    QTILE = "packages/SystemUI/src/com/android/systemui/qs/tileimpl/QSTileImpl.java"
    QSHOST = "packages/SystemUI/src/com/android/systemui/qs/QSHost.java"
    ADAPTER = "packages/SystemUI/src/com/android/systemui/qs/QSHostAdapter.kt"
    TILES = "packages/SystemUI/src/com/android/systemui/qs/tiles/"

    def test_java_still_parses(self):
        self.assert_java_syntax(self.QTILE)
        self.assert_java_syntax(self.QSHOST)
        for name in JAVA_TILES:
            self.assert_java_syntax(self.TILES + name)

    def test_all_action_paths_route_through_the_gate(self):
        self.assert_contains(
            self.QTILE,
            "handleAction(Action.CLICK, () -> handleClick(view));",
            "handleAction(Action.SECONDARY_CLICK, () -> handleSecondaryClick(view));",
            "handleAction(Action.LONG_CLICK, () -> handleLongClick(view));",
        )

    def test_gate_requires_unlock_on_a_secure_keyguard(self):
        self.assert_contains(
            self.QTILE,
            "public boolean isAllowedWhenLocked(Action action) {\n"
            "        return false;\n"
            "    }",
            "KeyguardStateController ksc = mHost.getKeyguardStateController();",
            "boolean hasSecureKeyguard = ksc.isMethodSecure() && ksc.isShowing();",
            "mActivityStarter.postQSRunnableDismissingKeyguard(handler);",
        )

    def test_logging_still_runs_before_the_gate(self):
        body = self.text(self.QTILE)
        for log, action in (
            ("mQSLogger.logHandleClick(mTileSpec, msg.arg1);",
             "handleAction(Action.CLICK"),
            ("mQSLogger.logHandleSecondaryClick(mTileSpec, msg.arg1);",
             "handleAction(Action.SECONDARY_CLICK"),
            ("mQSLogger.logHandleLongClick(mTileSpec, msg.arg1);",
             "handleAction(Action.LONG_CLICK"),
        ):
            self.assertIn(log, body)
            self.assertLess(body.index(log), body.index(action),
                            f"{log} must come before the gate, as upstream")

    def test_policy_disabled_tiles_keep_the_stock_dialog(self):
        self.assert_contains(
            self.QTILE,
            "if (mState.disabledByPolicy) {",
            "mActivityStarter.postStartActivityDismissingKeyguard(intent, 0);",
        )

    def test_no_toast_leftovers(self):
        patch = VENDOR / "patches/frameworks_base/0004-lenos-qs-unlock-gating.patch"
        patch_text = patch.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
        for needle in ("lenos_qs_unlock_required", "showUnlockRequired",
                       "Toast.makeText", "LENOS_LOCKED_ALLOWED_TILES"):
            self.assertNotIn(needle, patch_text)
        self.assert_not_contains(self.QTILE, "showUnlockRequired", "Toast.makeText")

    def test_host_exposes_keyguard_state(self):
        self.assert_contains(
            self.QSHOST,
            "com.android.systemui.statusbar.policy.KeyguardStateController "
            "getKeyguardStateController();",
        )
        self.assert_contains(
            self.ADAPTER,
            "private val keyguardStateController_: KeyguardStateController,",
            "override fun getKeyguardStateController() = keyguardStateController_",
        )

    def test_allowlisted_tiles_match_grapheneos(self):
        for name in JAVA_TILES:
            self.assert_contains(
                self.TILES + name,
                "@Override\n"
                "    public boolean isAllowedWhenLocked(QSTileImpl.Action action) {\n"
                "        return true;\n"
                "    }",
            )
        for name in KOTLIN_TILES:
            self.assert_contains(
                self.TILES + name,
                "override fun isAllowedWhenLocked(action: QSTileImpl.Action): Boolean = true",
            )

    def test_sensitive_tiles_are_not_allowlisted(self):
        patch = VENDOR / "patches/frameworks_base/0004-lenos-qs-unlock-gating.patch"
        patch_text = patch.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
        for name in SENSITIVE_TILES:
            self.assertNotIn(name, patch_text,
                             f"{name} must not be allow-listed on the lock screen")

"""Checks for the opt-in root path.

These tests prove the repository still defaults to rootless, that the root mode
is a post-build init_boot transform, and that the packaging shell path uses
--prepatched with verification. They use fake avbroot/manager fixtures and do
not build, download, flash, or boot anything.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import contextlib
import hashlib
import io
import json
import os
import shlex
import shutil
import struct
import subprocess
import sys
import tempfile
import unittest
import zipfile
import zlib
from pathlib import Path

from harness import VENDOR

TOOLS = VENDOR / "tools"
DRIVER = VENDOR / "lenos-1.0-shizuku.sh"
ROOT_TOOL = TOOLS / "lenos_root.py"
ROOT_HELPER = TOOLS / "apk_signing_cert.py"
PROFILES = TOOLS / "root-managers.json"


def _lp(data: bytes) -> bytes:
    return struct.pack("<I", len(data)) + data


def make_fake_apk(path: Path, cert: bytes = b"test signer certificate") -> tuple[int, str]:
    """Write a minimal ZIP with an APK v2 signing block and return cert pins."""
    buffer = io.BytesIO()
    with zipfile.ZipFile(buffer, "w") as archive:
        archive.writestr("AndroidManifest.xml", b"fake manifest\n")
    data = bytearray(buffer.getvalue())
    eocd = data.rfind(b"PK\x05\x06")
    central_directory = struct.unpack_from("<I", data, eocd + 16)[0]
    digests = _lp(b"")
    certificates = _lp(cert)
    signed = _lp(digests) + _lp(certificates) + _lp(b"")
    signer = _lp(signed) + _lp(b"") + _lp(b"")
    v2 = _lp(_lp(signer))
    pair = struct.pack("<Q", 4 + len(v2)) + struct.pack("<I", 0x7109871A) + v2
    block_size = len(pair) + 24
    block = (
        struct.pack("<Q", block_size)
        + pair
        + struct.pack("<Q", block_size)
        + b"APK Sig Block 42"
    )
    data[central_directory:central_directory] = block
    new_eocd = data.rfind(b"PK\x05\x06")
    struct.pack_into("<I", data, new_eocd + 16, central_directory + len(block))
    path.write_bytes(data)
    return len(cert), hashlib.sha256(cert).hexdigest()

class TestRootProfiles(unittest.TestCase):
    def setUp(self):
        self.data = json.loads(PROFILES.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))

    def test_profiles_are_pinned_for_the_asteroids_kmi(self):
        self.assertEqual(self.data["schema"], 1)
        self.assertEqual(self.data["kmi"], "android15-6.6")
        self.assertEqual(self.data["arch"], "aarch64")
        self.assertIn("bakasu", self.data["profiles"])
        self.assertIn("kernelsu", self.data["profiles"])

    def test_every_asset_uses_a_full_sha256_and_a_real_url(self):
        self.assertRegex(self.data["patcher"]["sha256"], r"^[0-9a-f]{64}$")
        self.assertTrue(self.data["patcher"]["url"].startswith("https://"))
        self.assertNotIn("nightly.link", self.data["patcher"]["url"])
        for name, profile in self.data["profiles"].items():
            manager = profile["manager"]
            self.assertRegex(manager["sha256"], r"^[0-9a-f]{64}$")
            self.assertTrue(manager["url"].startswith("https://"), name)
            self.assertNotIn("nightly.link", manager["url"])
            for key in ("lkm", "init"):
                blob = profile[key]
                self.assertRegex(blob["sha256"], r"^[0-9a-f]{64}$")
                self.assertRegex(blob["member_sha256"], r"^[0-9a-f]{64}$")
                embedded = blob.get("embedded")
                if embedded is not None:
                    self.assertEqual(embedded["asset"], "manager")
                    self.assertRegex(embedded["sha256"], r"^[0-9a-f]{64}$")
                    self.assertIsInstance(embedded["offset"], int)
                    self.assertGreaterEqual(embedded["offset"], 0)
                    self.assertEqual(embedded["compression"], "raw-deflate")
                    self.assertNotIn("url", blob)
                else:
                    self.assertTrue(blob["url"].startswith("https://"), name)
                    self.assertNotIn("nightly.link", blob["url"])

    def test_manager_certificates_are_pinned(self):
        for name, profile in self.data["profiles"].items():
            manager = profile["manager"]
            self.assertIsInstance(manager["cert_size"], int)
            self.assertRegex(manager["cert_sha256"], r"^[0-9a-f]{64}$")
            self.assertTrue(manager["cert_size"] > 0, name)

    def test_expected_pins_have_not_drifted(self):
        self.assertNotIn("resukisu", self.data["profiles"])
        bakasu = self.data["profiles"]["bakasu"]
        self.assertEqual(
            bakasu["source_commit"],
            "239e1e8871b8fcd51a6e5b3002e0ba522fdd99fb",
        )
        self.assertEqual(
            bakasu["manager"]["sha256"],
            "25657bc449439687608fffa04b4b586de90fc405e3dc6217bd997fc71ba0a0a1",
        )
        self.assertEqual(
            bakasu["lkm"]["member_sha256"],
            "4241d4334d22b5824023c848086f803973b8af44f28032572bd1146cd938501d",
        )
        self.assertEqual(
            bakasu["init"]["member_sha256"],
            "761afc0cac6ad839685493246cb352fa70a51ac2898daad70d1e88bf394b6dde",
        )
        self.assertEqual(
            bakasu["lkm"]["embedded"]["sha256"],
            "c80b0cb7a5b240ea442a3963f2f0cfabde0b1cd197056772793064766ae9263a",
        )
        self.assertEqual(bakasu["lkm"]["embedded"]["offset"], 920170)
        self.assertEqual(bakasu["init"]["embedded"]["offset"], 2405158)
        kernelsu = self.data["profiles"]["kernelsu"]
        self.assertEqual(
            kernelsu["manager"]["sha256"],
            "b4a059ace71de2fa65cc7f12b1c58d55fc23ab25e057ee4230ce779742abe450",
        )
        self.assertEqual(
            kernelsu["lkm"]["member_sha256"],
            "e57ce23de951be6b0dee5030f6724322fed126aa4af71828994437bfb0bb61ad",
        )

    def test_patcher_is_the_host_binary(self):
        patcher = self.data["patcher"]
        self.assertIn("x86_64", patcher["name"])
        self.assertIn("ksud", patcher["name"])
        self.assertEqual(
            patcher["sha256"],
            "29b50f946a3cc40b04aef3dd587adad227fe0f70edf9c56b02c84479f0b0e954",
        )


class TestRootDriver(unittest.TestCase):
    def run_driver(self, *args: str, env: dict[str, str] | None = None):
        command_env = os.environ.copy()
        command_env.pop("LENOS_ROOT", None)
        command_env.update(env or {})
        return subprocess.run(
            [str(DRIVER), *args],
            cwd=str(VENDOR),
            text=True,
            encoding="utf-8",
            errors="replace",
            stdout=subprocess.PIPE,
            stderr=subprocess.PIPE,
            check=False,
            env=command_env,
        )

    def test_default_flash_plan_is_rootless(self):
        result = self.run_driver("flash-plan")
        self.assertEqual(result.returncode, 0, result.stderr)
        self.assertIn("ROOTLESS", result.stdout)
        self.assertNotIn("manager.apk", result.stdout)

    def test_bakasu_flash_plan_is_mode_aware(self):
        result = self.run_driver(
            "flash-plan", env={"LENOS_ROOT": "bakasu"}
        )
        self.assertEqual(result.returncode, 0, result.stderr)
        self.assertIn("ROOT (bakasu)", result.stdout)
        self.assertIn("lenos-asteroids-bakasu-manager.apk", result.stdout)
        self.assertIn("extracted-bakasu", result.stdout)
        self.assertIn('scp "build-host:', result.stdout)
        self.assertNotIn("ROOTLESS", result.stdout)

    def test_cli_root_flag_matches_environment(self):
        result = self.run_driver("--root", "kernelsu", "flash-plan")
        self.assertEqual(result.returncode, 0, result.stderr)
        self.assertIn("ROOT (kernelsu)", result.stdout)

    def test_empty_cli_root_is_rejected(self):
        result = self.run_driver("--root=", "package")
        self.assertEqual(result.returncode, 1)
        self.assertIn("invalid LENOS_ROOT", result.stderr)

    def test_unknown_root_mode_is_rejected_before_anything_runs(self):
        result = self.run_driver(
            "package", env={"LENOS_ROOT": "magisk"}
        )
        self.assertEqual(result.returncode, 1)
        self.assertIn("invalid LENOS_ROOT", result.stderr)

    def test_lock_gates_always_refuse(self):
        rootless = self.run_driver("lock-gates")
        self.assertEqual(rootless.returncode, 1)
        self.assertIn("refusing to print a lock sequence", rootless.stdout)
        self.assertNotIn("fastboot flashing lock", rootless.stdout)
        self.assertNotIn("avb_custom_key", rootless.stdout)
        for mode in ("bakasu", "kernelsu"):
            result = self.run_driver("lock-gates", env={"LENOS_ROOT": mode})
            self.assertEqual(result.returncode, 1)
            self.assertIn("will not run", result.stdout)
            self.assertIn("REFERENCE ONLY", result.stdout)
            self.assertIn("does not install or verify", result.stdout)
            self.assertNotIn("fastboot erase", result.stdout)
            self.assertNotIn("fastboot flash", result.stdout)
            self.assertNotIn("fastboot flashing lock", result.stdout)

    def test_root_packaging_uses_prepatched_and_requires_init_boot(self):
        text = DRIVER.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
        self.assertIn('ROOT_MODE="none"', text)
        self.assertIn('args+=(--prepatched "$ROOT_STATE_DIR/init_boot.img")', text)
        self.assertIn(
            "for required in init_boot boot vendor_boot vbmeta", text
        )
        self.assertIn(
            'need_file "$WS/lenos-asteroids-$ROOT_MODE-manager.apk"', text
        )
        self.assertIn('parts_text="$(collect_os_resign)"', text)
        self.assertIn("check-source", text)
        self.assertIn("root-prepare", text)
        self.assertIn("root-status", text)

        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as directory:

                "x\n", encoding="utf-8"

            for name in ("lenos-patch.py", "lenos_projects.py", "apk_signing_cert.py"):
                shutil.copy2(TOOLS / name, vendor / "tools" / name)
            for name in ("firmware-deny.txt", "root-managers.json"):
                shutil.copy2(TOOLS / name, vendor / "tools" / name)
            stub_log = root / "lenos-root.log"
            stub = vendor / "tools/lenos_root.py"
            stub.write_text(
                "#!/usr/bin/env python3\n"
                "import os, sys\n"
                'with open(os.environ["FAKE_ROOT_LOG"], "a") as f:\n'
                '    f.write(" ".join(sys.argv[1:]) + "\\n")\n'

            wizard = root / "fake-wizard.sh"

            (state / "init_boot.img").write_bytes(b"state init")
            (state / "manager.apk").write_bytes(b"manager")
            (state / "root-state.json").write_text("{}\n", encoding="utf-8")
            log = root / "avbroot.log"
            fake = root / "avbroot"
            fake.write_text(
                "#!/usr/bin/env bash\n"
                "set -euo pipefail\n"
                'printf \'%s\\n\' "$*" >> "${FAKE_AVBROOT_LOG:?}"\n'
                'if [[ "${1:-}" == "--version" ]]; then\n'
                '  echo "avbroot 3.33.0"\n'
                "  exit 0\n"
                "fi\n"
                'if [[ "${1:-}" == "boot" && "${2:-}" == "unpack" '
                '&& "${3:-}" == "--help" ]]; then exit 0; fi\n'
                'if [[ "${1:-}" == "cpio" && "${2:-}" == "unpack" '
                '&& "${3:-}" == "--help" ]]; then exit 0; fi\n'
                'if [[ "${1:-}" == "ota" && "${2:-}" == "verify" ]]; then exit 0; fi\n'
                'if [[ "${1:-}" == "ota" && "${2:-}" == "patch" ]]; then\n'
                '  out=""\n'
                "  saw_prepatched=0\n"
                "  shift 2\n"
                "  while (($#)); do\n"
                '    case "$1" in\n'
                '      --output) out="$2"; shift 2;;\n'
                '      --prepatched) saw_prepatched=1; shift 2;;\n'
                '      --rootless) echo "unexpected --rootless" >&2; exit 2;;\n'
                "      *) shift;;\n"
                "    esac\n"
                "  done\n"
                '  [[ -n "$out" && "$saw_prepatched" -eq 1 ]] || exit 2\n'
                '  printf "fake root OTA\\n" > "$out"\n'
                "  exit 0\n"
                "fi\n"
                'if [[ "${1:-}" == "ota" && "${2:-}" == "extract" ]]; then\n'
                '  dir=""\n'
                "  shift 2\n"
                "  while (($#)); do\n"
                '    case "$1" in\n'
                '      --directory) dir="$2"; shift 2;;\n'
                "      *) shift;;\n"
                "    esac\n"
                "  done\n"
                '  [[ -n "$dir" ]] || exit 2\n'
                '  mkdir -p "$dir"\n'
                '  printf "boot\\n" > "$dir/boot.img"\n'
                '  printf "init_boot\\n" > "$dir/init_boot.img"\n'
                '  printf "vendor_boot\\n" > "$dir/vendor_boot.img"\n'
                "  exit 0\n"
                "fi\n"
                "exit 1\n",

            fake.chmod(0o755)
            result = self.run_driver(
                "package",
                env={
                    "LENOS_ROOT": "bakasu",
                    "LENOS_WORKSPACE": str(ws),

            self.assertEqual(result.returncode, 0, result.stderr)
            avb = log.read_text(encoding="utf-8")

            self.assertIn("check-source", calls)
            self.assertIn("status", calls)
            self.assertIn("verify-image", calls)
            self.assertTrue((ws / "lenos-asteroids-bakasu.zip").is_file())
            self.assertTrue((ws / "lenos-asteroids-bakasu-manager.apk").is_file())

class TestRootHelpers(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_cpio_parser_reads_modes_and_duplicate_entries(self):
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as directory:
            info = Path(directory) / "cpio.toml"
            info.write_text(
                "format = \"Lz4Legacy\"\n"
                "\n[[entries]]\n"
                "path = \"init\"\n"
                "file_type = \"Regular\"\n"
                "file_mode = \"755\"\n"
                "\n[[entries]]\n"
                "path = \"init.real\"\n"
                "file_type = \"Regular\"\n"
                "file_mode = \"750\"\n",
                encoding="utf-8",
            )
            entries = lenos_root.parse_cpio_info(info)
        self.assertEqual(entries["init"]["file_mode"], "755")
        self.assertTrue(lenos_root._is_executable(entries["init"]))
        self.assertTrue(lenos_root._is_executable(entries["init.real"]))
        self.assertFalse(lenos_root._is_executable({"file_mode": "644"}))

    def test_partition_limit_comes_from_the_device_tree(self):
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as directory:
            source = Path(directory)
            board = source / "device/nothing/asteroids/BoardConfig.mk"
            board.parent.mkdir(parents=True)
            board.write_text(
                "BOARD_INIT_BOOT_IMAGE_PARTITION_SIZE := 0x800000\n",
                encoding="utf-8",
            )
            self.assertEqual(lenos_root.board_partition_limit(source), 8 * 1024 * 1024)

    def test_embedded_raw_deflate_payload_is_extracted_and_pinned(self):
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as directory:
            root = Path(directory)
            payload = b"\x7fELF" + b"fake BakaSU payload\n"
            compressor = zlib.compressobj(level=9, wbits=-15)
            compressed = compressor.compress(payload) + compressor.flush()
            prefix = b"BakaSU embedded ksud\n"
            blob = prefix + compressed
            manager = root / "manager.apk"
            with zipfile.ZipFile(manager, "w") as archive:
                archive.writestr("lib/arm64-v8a/libksud.so", blob)
            digest = hashlib.sha256(payload).hexdigest()
            asset = {
                "name": "android15-6.6_kernelsu.ko",
                "sha256": digest,
                "member_sha256": digest,
                "embedded": {
                    "asset": "manager",
                    "member": "lib/arm64-v8a/libksud.so",
                    "sha256": hashlib.sha256(blob).hexdigest(),
                    "offset": len(prefix),
                    "compression": "raw-deflate",
                },
            }
            output = root / "kernelsu.ko"
            lenos_root.extract_embedded_asset(manager, asset, output)
            self.assertEqual(output.read_bytes(), payload)
            self.assertEqual(output.stat().st_mode & 0o777, 0o644)

            executable = root / "ksuinit"
            lenos_root.extract_embedded_asset(
                manager, asset, executable, executable=True
            )
            self.assertEqual(executable.read_bytes(), payload)
            self.assertEqual(executable.stat().st_mode & 0o777, 0o755)

            asset["member_sha256"] = "0" * 64
            with self.assertRaises(lenos_root.RootError):
                lenos_root.extract_embedded_asset(manager, asset, output)

            fake.chmod(0o755)

class TestFastbootSanitizer(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_every_pinned_firmware_partition_is_commented(self):
        firmware = sanitize_fastboot_info.load_deny(TOOLS / "firmware-deny.txt")
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as directory:
            info = Path(directory) / "fastboot-info.txt"
            names = sorted(firmware)
            info.write_text(
                "\n".join(
                    [f"flash {name}" for name in names]
                    + ["flash system", "flash vbmeta", "update-super", "reboot fastboot"]
                )
                + "\n",
                encoding="utf-8",
            )
            saw_reboot, saw_logical = sanitize_fastboot_info.sanitize(info, firmware)
            text = info.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
        self.assertTrue(saw_reboot)
        self.assertTrue(saw_logical)
        for name in names:
            self.assertNotIn(f"\nflash {name}\n", "\n" + text)
            self.assertIn(f"# flash {name}", text)
        self.assertIn("\nflash system\n", "\n" + text)
        self.assertIn("\nupdate-super\n", "\n" + text)
        self.assertLess(text.index("flash system"), text.index("flash vbmeta"))

    def test_vbmeta_is_after_every_logical_partition(self):
        firmware = sanitize_fastboot_info.load_deny(TOOLS / "firmware-deny.txt")
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as directory:
            info = Path(directory) / "fastboot-info.txt"
            info.write_text(
                "flash boot\n"
                "flash system\n"
                "flash vbmeta\n"
                "flash product\n"
                "flash vbmeta_system\n"
                "update-super\n"
                "reboot fastboot\n",
                encoding="utf-8",
            )
            sanitize_fastboot_info.sanitize(info, firmware)
            text = info.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
        self.assertLess(text.index("flash system"), text.index("flash vbmeta"))
        self.assertLess(text.index("flash product"), text.index("flash vbmeta"))
        self.assertLess(text.index("update-super"), text.index("flash vbmeta"))
        self.assertLess(text.index("flash vbmeta"), text.index("reboot fastboot"))


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()

"""Screenshot EXIF privacy (SystemUI + Settings, see docs/features.md).

Feature contract (GrapheneOS-faithful port):
* SystemUI screenshots are exported with no timestamp, timezone, sub-second or
  build-identifier EXIF metadata unless ``ExtSettings.SCREENSHOT_TIMESTAMP_EXIF``
  (``Settings.Secure.screenshot_timestamp_exif``, default off) is enabled. The
  gate is applied in ``ImageExporter.writeExif`` by nulling ``captureTime``;
  ``updateExifAttributes`` is nullable and returns before writing any date
  tags. LineageOS's ``TAG_SOFTWARE = "Android " + Build.DISPLAY`` line is
  removed to match GrapheneOS/AOSP, which never write a build string.
* The SystemUI gate reads the per-user ExtSettings value; the Settings toggle
  ``privacy_screenshot_timestamp_exif`` (More security & privacy) writes it
  through ``BoolSettingPrefController``. GrapheneOS wires the row via the
  ``settings:boolSettingField`` XML attribute, which lenOS does not port; the
  controller is registered explicitly in ``MoreSecurityPrivacyFragment``.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import unittest

from harness import LenosPatchTest


class TestScreenshotExifEnforcement(LenosPatchTest):
    PROJECT = "frameworks/base"
    PATCHES = ["0013-lenos-screenshot-exif-privacy.patch"]
    SRC = ("packages/SystemUI/src/com/android/systemui/screenshot/"
           "ImageExporter.java")

    def test_timestamp_gated_by_ext_settings(self):
        self.assert_contains(
            self.SRC,
            "import android.ext.settings.ExtSettings;",
            """if (!ExtSettings.SCREENSHOT_TIMESTAMP_EXIF.get(resolver.getContext())) {
                captureTime = null;
            }""",
        )

    def test_exif_writer_skips_date_tags_when_null(self):
        self.assert_contains(
            self.SRC,
            "@Nullable ZonedDateTime captureTime",
            """if (captureTime == null) {
            return;
        }""",
            "TAG_DATETIME_ORIGINAL",
        )

    def test_no_build_string_is_written(self):
        # LineageOS adds TAG_SOFTWARE = "Android " + Build.DISPLAY; GrapheneOS
        # and AOSP write no software tag, so the line (and its import) go away.
        self.assert_not_contains(self.SRC, "exif.setAttribute(ExifInterface.TAG_SOFTWARE")
        self.assert_not_contains(self.SRC, "import android.os.Build;")

    def test_syntax(self):
        self.assert_java_syntax(self.SRC)


class TestScreenshotExifSetting(LenosPatchTest):
    PROJECT = "packages/apps/Settings"
    PATCHES = ["0001-lenos-ext-settings-ui.patch"]
    XML = "res/xml/more_security_privacy_settings.xml"
    FRAGMENT = "src/com/android/settings/safetycenter/MoreSecurityPrivacyFragment.java"
    STRINGS = "res/values/strings_ext.xml"

    def test_row_uses_grapheneos_strings_and_key(self):
        self.assert_contains(
            self.XML,
            'android:key="privacy_screenshot_timestamp_exif"',
            '@string/screenshot_timestamp_exif_title',
            '@string/screenshot_timestamp_exif_summary',
        )
        # The GrapheneOS auto-wiring attribute is not ported.
        self.assert_not_contains(self.XML, 'settings:boolSettingField="')

    def test_strings_match_grapheneos(self):
        self.assert_contains(
            self.STRINGS,
            '<string name="screenshot_timestamp_exif_title">'

"""GrapheneOS: user-revocable sensors permission (OTHER_SENSORS).

Tier 2 feature. It plugs into the "special runtime permissions" (SRT)
framework introduced with the network permission (``fwb/0025``):

* ``android.permission.OTHER_SENSORS`` is a ``dangerous`` permission in its
  own ``android.permission-group.OTHER_SENSORS`` group ("Sensors").
* Every sensor that has no other required permission (accelerometer, gyro,
  compass, ...) is tagged with ``OTHER_SENSORS`` at the ``Sensor`` object
  level (``libs/sensor/Sensor.cpp``); the sensor service then denies access
  for app UIDs that do not hold it (``SensorService::canAccessSensor``).
* As an SRT it is granted by default on install unless the
  ``AUTO_GRANT_OTHER_SENSORS_PERMISSION`` ExtSettings setting (default on) is
  turned off, in which case the user grants it manually. App updates never
  re-grant a revoked permission (the ``isNewlyInstalledInUserId`` gate from
  the network port).
* Denied accesses post a rate-limited "X tried to access sensors"
  notification with a "Don't show again" action (sets USER_SET and suppresses
  the notification for that app).
* System processes (UID < AID_APP_START, e.g. the closed-source gpsd daemon)
  keep their access. Apps targeting pre-Q that used the step counter without
  ACTIVITY_RECOGNITION get OTHER_SENSORS enforced instead.

The SRT registry and the PermissionController mapping live in the owning
network-permission patches (``fwb/0025`` / ``Permission/0002``); this module
tests the sensors-specific enforcement and the notification stack.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import unittest

from harness import LenosPatchTest


class TestSensorsPermissionFramework(LenosPatchTest):
    PROJECT = "frameworks/base"
    PATCHES = [
        "0025-lenos-network-permission.patch",
        "0026-lenos-sensors-permission.patch",
    ]

    MANIFEST = "core/res/AndroidManifest.xml"
    STRINGS = "core/res/res/values/strings.xml"
    SRPU = "services/core/java/com/android/server/pm/permission/SpecialRuntimePermUtils.java"
    PMN = "services/core/java/com/android/server/pm/PackageManagerNative.java"
    NOTIF = ("services/core/java/com/android/server/ext/"
             "MissingSpecialRuntimePermissionNotification.java")
    RECEIVER = "services/core/java/com/android/server/ext/IntentReceiver.java"
    SSE = "services/core/java/com/android/server/ext/SseUtils.java"
    CHANNELS = "core/java/com/android/internal/notification/SystemNotificationChannels.java"
    PROTO = "proto/src/system_messages.proto"

    def test_manifest_declares_the_sensors_permission(self):
        self.assert_contains(
            self.MANIFEST,
            '<permission-group android:name="android.permission-group.OTHER_SENSORS"',
            'android:icon="@drawable/perm_group_location"',
            'android:label="@string/permgrouplab_otherSensors"',
            'android:description="@string/permgroupdesc_otherSensors"',
            'android:priority="1000"',
            '<permission android:name="android.permission.OTHER_SENSORS"',
            'android:permissionGroup="android.permission-group.UNDEFINED"',
            'android:protectionLevel="dangerous" />')
        self.assert_xml(self.MANIFEST)

    def test_strings(self):
        self.assert_contains(
            self.STRINGS,
            '<string name="permgrouplab_otherSensors">Sensors</string>',
            '<string name="permgroupdesc_otherSensors">'
            'access sensor data about orientation, movement, etc.</string>',
            'name="permlab_otherSensors"',
            'name="permdesc_otherSensors"',
            '<string name="notification_channel_missing_permission">'
            'Missing permission</string>',
            '<string name="missing_sensors_permission_title">'
            '%1$s tried to access sensors</string>',
            '<string name="missing_sensors_permission_message">'
            'Tap to ask for permission.</string>',
            '<string name="notification_action_dont_show_again">'
            'Don\u2019t show again</string>')
        self.assert_xml(self.STRINGS)

    def test_srt_registry_and_auto_grant(self):
        self.assert_contains(
            self.SRPU,
            "Manifest.permission.OTHER_SENSORS,",
            "ExtSettings.AUTO_GRANT_OTHER_SENSORS_PERMISSION.get(ctx, userIdForSettings)",
            "um.getProfileParentId(userId)")
        text = self.text(self.SRPU)
        start = text.index("specialRuntimePermissions = new ArraySet<>")
        block = text[start:text.index("});", start)]
        self.assertIn("Manifest.permission.INTERNET,", block)
        self.assertIn("Manifest.permission.OTHER_SENSORS,", block)
        # Sensors have no bind-time compatibility mode: only INTERNET sets a
        # flag in the bind-args computation.
        flags_body = text[text.index("public static int getFlags"):
                          text.index("private static boolean shouldEnableInternetCompat")]
        self.assertIn("case Manifest.permission.INTERNET:", flags_body)
        self.assertNotIn("OTHER_SENSORS", flags_body)

    def test_denied_op_reaches_system_server(self):
        self.assert_contains(
            self.PMN,
            "public void onDeniedSpecialRuntimePermissionOp(String permissionName, int uid,",
            "if (Binder.getCallingUid() != android.os.Process.SYSTEM_UID) {",
            "throw new SecurityException();",
            ".maybeShow(mPm.mContext, permissionName, uid, packageName);")

    def test_notification_is_rate_limited_and_respects_dont_show_again(self):
        self.assert_contains(
            self.NOTIF,
            "private static final ArrayMap<String, SparseLongArray> lastShownTracker",
            "if (prevTs != 0 && (timestamp - prevTs) < 30_000L) {",
            "if ((permFlags & PackageManager.FLAG_PERMISSION_USER_SET) != 0) {",
            "SystemMessage.NOTE_MISSING_PERMISSION_OTHER_SENSORS",
            "R.string.missing_sensors_permission_message",
            "PackageManager.ACTION_REQUEST_PERMISSIONS_FOR_OTHER",
            "R.string.notification_action_dont_show_again",
            ".updatePermissionFlags(packageName, permissionName, flag, flag, user);",
            ".cancelAsUser(null, notifIdForPermission(permissionName), user);")
        self.assert_java_syntax(self.NOTIF)

    def test_notification_helpers(self):
        self.assert_contains(
            self.RECEIVER,
            "ctx.registerReceiver(instance, filter, null,",
            "Context.RECEIVER_NOT_EXPORTED);",
            "public PendingIntent getPendingIntent(@Nullable Bundle args) {",
            "i.setIdentifier(Long.toString(id));")
        self.assert_contains(
            self.SSE,
            "public static void addNotifAction(",
            "dst.addAction(nb.build());")
        self.assert_java_syntax(self.RECEIVER)
        self.assert_java_syntax(self.SSE)

    def test_notification_channel(self):
        self.assert_contains(
            self.CHANNELS,
            'public static final String MISSING_PERMISSION = "MISSING_PERMISSION";',
            "context.getString(R.string.notification_channel_missing_permission)",
            "missingPermissionChannel.setBlockable(true);")

    def test_proto_id(self):
        text = self.text(self.PROTO)
        self.assertIn("NOTE_MISSING_PERMISSION_OTHER_SENSORS = 500;", text)
        self.assertLess(text.index("NOTE_MISSING_PERMISSION_OTHER_SENSORS = 500;"),
                        text.index("// ADD_NEW_IDS_ABOVE_THIS_LINE"))

    def test_java_syntax(self):
        for rel in (self.PMN, self.CHANNELS, self.SRPU):
            self.assert_java_syntax(rel)


class TestSensorsPermissionNative(LenosPatchTest):

            "__ANDROID_API_P__",

"""SSAID/ANDROID_ID rotation on reinstall (frameworks/base SettingsProvider).

Feature contract (see docs/features.md):
* An app that is *installed anew* gets a different ANDROID_ID than it had before.
* An app that is merely *upgraded* keeps its ANDROID_ID.
* The identifier stays scoped per user (per-user secret) and per signing key.
* Users can turn the behaviour off, which restores stock AOSP derivation.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import unittest

from harness import LenosPatchTest


class TestSsaidRotation(LenosPatchTest):
    PROJECT = "frameworks/base"
    PATCHES = ["0001-ssaid-rotate-on-reinstall.patch"]
    F = "packages/SettingsProvider/src/com/android/providers/settings/SettingsProvider.java"

    def test_still_syntactically_valid_java(self):
        self.assert_java_syntax(self.F)

    def test_install_generation_is_part_of_the_derivation(self):
        self.assert_contains(
            self.F,
            "final byte[] generation =\n                        ByteBuffer.allocate(8).putLong(callingPkg.firstInstallTime).array();",
            "if (includeInstallGeneration)",
        )

    def test_rotation_is_detected_by_comparing_stored_value(self):
        self.assert_contains(
            self.F,
            "isLenosSsaidRotationEnabled()",
            "!isSsaidUpToDateLocked(ssaid, callingPkg, owningUserId)",
            "computeSsaidLocked(callingPkg, owningUserId,\n                /* includeInstallGeneration= */ true)",
        )

    def test_rotation_can_be_disabled_by_a_user_visible_setting(self):
        self.assert_contains(
            self.F,
            'public static final String LENOS_SSAID_ROTATION_ENABLED = "lenos_ssaid_rotation_enabled";',
            "LENOS_SSAID_ROTATION_ENABLED, 1) != 0;",
        )

    def test_aosp_derivation_is_preserved_without_the_generation(self):
        # When rotation is off, the value must be byte-for-byte the AOSP value:
        # signatures only, no extra HMAC input.
        self.assert_contains(
            self.F,
            "if (includeInstallGeneration) {",
            "return HexEncoding.encodeToString(m.doFinal(), false /* upperCase */)",
        )

    def test_original_behaviour_for_missing_ssaid_is_kept(self):
        # The lazy-initialise path must still store the value it computed.
        self.assert_contains(
            self.F,
            "Setting setting = mSettingsRegistry.generateSsaidLocked(callingPkg, owningUserId);\n"
            "            return mascaradeSsaidSetting(ssaidSettings, setting);",
        )

    def test_no_schema_change(self):
        # The feature must not change the settings database layout: it stores
        # the rotated value in the existing ssaid table entry for the uid.
        body = self.text(self.F)
        self.assertNotIn("ALTER TABLE", body)
        self.assertNotIn("DATABASE_VERSION", body)

"""GrapheneOS: per-user app installation policy (#19).

GrapheneOS exposes the standard user restrictions ``DISALLOW_INSTALL_APPS``
and ``DISALLOW_INSTALL_UNKNOWN_SOURCES`` on the user details screen, so the
owner can set, for each secondary user (or the guest), one of three policies:

* apps and updates allowed,
* first-party sources only (unknown sources blocked),
* no installs or updates.

The device-management restriction is a normal platform feature, so the port is
the Settings UI plus a small restriction helper — the framework already
enforces it in ``PackageInstallerService``/``InstallPackageHelper``.

The port keeps GrapheneOS's ``Instrumentable.METRICS_CATEGORY_UNKNOWN`` (A17
defines it), puts the strings in a new ``strings_lenos_users.xml`` instead of
extending the lenOS ext-strings file, and trims the helper to the install path
(GrapheneOS's private-space inheritance is a separate feature).
"""

import unittest

from harness import LenosPatchTest

"""Static checks for the post-build and read-only device verification scripts."""
from __future__ import annotations

import os
import unittest

from harness import VENDOR


class TestVerificationScripts(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_scripts_are_present_and_executable(self):
        for name in ("verify-build.sh", "verify-device.sh"):
            path = VENDOR / "tools" / name
            self.assertTrue(path.is_file(), name)
            self.assertTrue(os.access(path, os.X_OK), f"{name} is not executable")

    def test_scripts_do_not_flash_or_change_the_device(self):
        forbidden = (
            "fastboot", "flash ", "flashall", "erase ", "wipe", "reboot",
            "settings put", "pm clear", "pm uninstall", "am force-stop",
            "cmd usb set", "svc wifi", "svc data", "rm -rf",
        )
        for name in ("verify-build.sh", "verify-device.sh"):
            # Comments explain what the script does not do; only inspect executable lines.
            lines = [line for line in
                     (VENDOR / "tools" / name).read_text(encoding="utf-8").splitlines()
                     if not line.lstrip().startswith("#")]
            body = "\n".join(lines).lower()
            for needle in forbidden:
                self.assertNotIn(needle, body, f"{name} contains {needle!r}")

    def test_device_probes_are_read_only(self):
        body = (VENDOR / "tools" / "verify-device.sh").read_text(encoding="utf-8")
        for needle in ("getprop", "settings get secure", "dumpsys usb", "pm path",
                       "dmesg_restrict", "/proc/config.gz"):
            self.assertIn(needle, body)
        self.assertIn("made no changes", body)

    def test_build_script_checks_expected_artifacts(self):
        body = (VENDOR / "tools" / "verify-build.sh").read_text(encoding="utf-8")
        for needle in ("framework.jar", "Settings/Settings.apk", "LenosOpsec",
                       "Seedvault", "system.img"):
            self.assertIn(needle, body)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()

====================================================================================================
"""VPN leak blocking: netd lockdown fixes, multicast firewall, NSD lockdown.

GrapheneOS-derived hardening for "Block connections without VPN" (see
docs/graphene-porting.md section 12):

* netd: the system resolver no longer marks every DNS query as protected from
  the VPN, so a lockdown device with all VPNs down can't fall back to the
  default network's DNS servers (GrapheneOS ``82da9204``).
* netd: a multicast firewall drops multicast/IGMP/MLD in, out and through
  ``tun+`` interfaces, closing the cross-profile VPN side channel while
  keeping inbound router advertisements (GrapheneOS ``dcef5ccb`` +
  ``d57ea8dc``).
* Connectivity: regular apps get no NSD connector while an always-on VPN with
  lockdown is active, because discovery traffic would bypass the tunnel
  (GrapheneOS NsdService check; helper ``android.ext.ConnectivityUtil``).
* fwb: an always-on VPN is no longer unset just because its package is
  temporarily unsupported (safe mode, disabled app); the lockdown fail-safe
  stays configured (GrapheneOS Vpn.java behaviour).

GrapheneOS's SockDiag IP-address logging fix (``40c47da2``) and the DnsResolver
``.local`` transport filter (AOSP ``a17ba5aee1``, 2022) are already present in
LineageOS 24.0, so no patch is needed for them.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import unittest

from harness import LenosPatchTest

    PROJECT = "system/netd"
    PATCHES = ["0001-lenos-vpn-leak-blocking.patch"]

    CTRL = "server/Controllers.cpp"
    CTRL_H = "server/Controllers.h"
    FW = "server/MulticastFirewallController.cpp"
    FW_H = "server/MulticastFirewallController.h"
    TEST = "server/MulticastFirewallControllerTest.cpp"
    BP = "server/Android.bp"

    def test_dns_mark_is_derived_from_caller(self):
        self.assert_contains(
            self.NETCTRL,
            "fwmark.protectedFromVpn = canProtectLocked(uid, *netId);",
            "fwmark.permission = getPermissionForUserLocked(uid);")
        self.assert_not_contains(self.NETCTRL, "fwmark.permission = PERMISSION_SYSTEM;")

    def test_multicast_controller_is_wired(self):
        self.assert_contains(
            self.CTRL,
            "MulticastFirewallController::LOCAL_INPUT",
            "MulticastFirewallController::LOCAL_FORWARD",
            "MulticastFirewallController::LOCAL_OUTPUT",

        self.assert_contains(self.CTRL_H,
                             '#include "MulticastFirewallController.h"',
                             "MulticastFirewallController multicastFirewallCtrl;")

    def test_rules_cover_v4_v6_igmp_mld_and_keep_ra(self):
        self.assert_contains(

            '"-4 -A mfw_INPUT -i %s -d %s -j DROP"',

"""Wi-Fi privacy defaults (packages/modules/Wifi patch, ported from GrapheneOS).

Feature contract (see docs/features.md):
* New Wi-Fi networks default to per-connection (non-persistent) MAC
  randomization: macRandomizationSetting starts at RANDOMIZATION_ALWAYS and
  the framework forces non-persistent randomization for that value. The user
  can still pick any other strategy per network; the default never overrides
  an explicit choice.
* DHCP requests never carry the device hostname by default: a new
  WifiConfiguration has SendDhcpHostname disabled, and only a per-network
  opt-in turns it back on.
* Existing saved networks keep their stored values. The XML tag was renamed
  (SendDhcpHostname -> SendDhcpHostname2) so values written by stock Android
  are ignored and the privacy default applies after the upgrade, matching
  GrapheneOS.

#!/usr/bin/env python3
# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
"""Extract the first signer certificate from an APK v2 signature and pin it.

This compares the certificate bytes only. It does not verify the APK's v2
signature or the APK contents; the full-file SHA-256 pin is the authentication
control. The certificate pin catches a manager APK signed by a different key
when both hashes are maintained together.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import hashlib
import struct
import sys
from pathlib import Path

EOCD = b"PK\x05\x06"
APK_SIG_MAGIC = b"APK Sig Block 42"
APK_SIGNATURE_SCHEME_V2_BLOCK_ID = 0x7109871A


class ApkError(RuntimeError):
    pass


def u32(data: bytes, offset: int) -> int:
    if offset < 0 or offset + 4 > len(data):
        raise ApkError("truncated uint32")
    return struct.unpack_from("<I", data, offset)[0]


def u64(data: bytes, offset: int) -> int:
    if offset < 0 or offset + 8 > len(data):
        raise ApkError("truncated uint64")
    return struct.unpack_from("<Q", data, offset)[0]


def length_prefixed(data: bytes, offset: int, end: int) -> tuple[int, int, int]:
    size = u32(data, offset)
    start = offset + 4
    value_end = start + size
    if value_end > end:
        raise ApkError("length-prefixed field exceeds container")
    return start, value_end, value_end


def first_v2_certificate(path: Path) -> bytes:
    data = path.read_bytes()
    eocd = data.rfind(EOCD, max(0, len(data) - 65557))
    if eocd < 0:
        raise ApkError("ZIP EOCD not found")
    central_directory = u32(data, eocd + 16)
    if central_directory < 24 or central_directory > len(data):
        raise ApkError("invalid central-directory offset")
    if data[central_directory - 16 : central_directory] != APK_SIG_MAGIC:
        raise ApkError("APK Signing Block magic not found")
    block_size = u64(data, central_directory - 24)
    block_start = central_directory - (block_size + 8)
    if block_start < 0 or u64(data, block_start) != block_size:
        raise ApkError("APK Signing Block size mismatch")

    position = block_start + 8
    pairs_end = central_directory - 24
    v2 = None
    while position < pairs_end:
        pair_size = u64(data, position)
        position += 8
        if pair_size < 4 or position + pair_size > pairs_end:
            raise ApkError("invalid APK Signing Block pair")
        block_id = u32(data, position)
        position += 4
        value_size = pair_size - 4
        value = data[position : position + value_size]
        position += value_size
        if block_id == APK_SIGNATURE_SCHEME_V2_BLOCK_ID:
            v2 = value
    if position != pairs_end or v2 is None:
        raise ApkError("APK v2 signature block not found")

    # v2 value: signers -> first signer -> signed data -> digests, certificates.
    signers_start, signers_end, _ = length_prefixed(v2, 0, len(v2))
    signer_start, signer_end, _ = length_prefixed(v2, signers_start, signers_end)
    signed_start, signed_end, _ = length_prefixed(v2, signer_start, signer_end)
    _, _, certificates_offset = length_prefixed(v2, signed_start, signed_end)
    certificates_start, certificates_end, _ = length_prefixed(
        v2, certificates_offset, signed_end
    )
    cert_start, cert_end, _ = length_prefixed(
        v2, certificates_start, certificates_end
    )
    return v2[cert_start:cert_end]


def verify_certificate(
    path: Path,
    *,
    expect_size: int | None = None,
    expect_sha256: str | None = None,
    extract: Path | None = None,
) -> tuple[int, str]:
    cert = first_v2_certificate(path)
    digest = hashlib.sha256(cert).hexdigest()
    if expect_size is not None and len(cert) != expect_size:
        raise ApkError(
            f"signer certificate size mismatch: {len(cert)} != {expect_size}"
        )
    if expect_sha256 is not None and digest != expect_sha256.lower():
        raise ApkError(
            f"signer certificate SHA-256 mismatch: {digest} != {expect_sha256}"
        )
    if extract is not None:
        extract.write_bytes(cert)
    return len(cert), digest


def main() -> int:
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument("apk", type=Path)
    parser.add_argument("--expect-size", type=int)
    parser.add_argument("--expect-sha256")
    parser.add_argument("--extract", type=Path)
    args = parser.parse_args()
    try:
        size, digest = verify_certificate(
            args.apk,
            expect_size=args.expect_size,
            expect_sha256=args.expect_sha256,
            extract=args.extract,
        )
        print(f"size={size}")
        print(f"sha256={digest}")
    except (OSError, ApkError, struct.error) as exc:
        print(f"error: {exc}", file=sys.stderr)
        return 1
    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    raise SystemExit(main())

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""lenos-patch — apply lenOS feature patches to a pinned LineageOS tree.

Design rules (see docs/build.md):

* Patches are ordinary unified diffs produced by ``git diff`` in the pinned
  upstream project. They are applied with ``git apply`` inside the project,
  never with fuzzy matching.
* A patch that does not apply is a hard error. Silently skipping a security
  feature because upstream moved a line is how you ship a broken OS.
* ``--check`` never writes. ``--reverse`` removes a feature (for bisecting).
* ``--reset`` returns the series' projects to their pinned revisions: it
  restores tracked files and deletes files the series creates (plain
  ``git checkout`` leaves those behind and then ``--check`` can never pass).
* Every project has ``patches/<project>/series`` listing patches in apply
  order; a patch not in the series is not applied.

Usage:
    lenos-patch.py --tree /path/to/lineage --check
    lenos-patch.py --tree /path/to/lineage --apply
    lenos-patch.py --tree /path/to/lineage --apply --project frameworks/base
    lenos-patch.py --tree /path/to/lineage --reverse --apply
    lenos-patch.py --tree /path/to/lineage --reset
    lenos-patch.py --tree /path/to/lineage --experimental --check
    lenos-patch.py --tree /path/to/lineage --experimental --apply
    lenos-patch.py --tree /path/to/lineage --experimental --reset
    lenos-patch.py --tree /path/to/lineage --require-applied
    lenos-patch.py --tree /path/to/lineage --experimental --require-applied
    lenos-patch.py --list [--experimental]

The experimental series is always applied **after** the stable 1.0 series and
must be checked/applied separately. It is not part of a default build.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import shutil
import subprocess
import sys
import tempfile
from pathlib import Path

sys.path.insert(0, str(Path(__file__).resolve().parent))
from lenos_projects import PROJECT_ALIASES, alias_for, project_for  # noqa: E402

HERE = Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent  # vendor/lenos
STABLE_PATCH_ROOT = HERE / "patches"
EXPERIMENTAL_PATCH_ROOT = HERE / "patches-experimental"


def patch_root_for(experimental: bool) -> Path:
    return EXPERIMENTAL_PATCH_ROOT if experimental else STABLE_PATCH_ROOT


def patch_dir_for(project: str, root: Path) -> Path:
    return root / alias_for(project)


def series(project: str, root: Path) -> list[Path]:
    pdir = patch_dir_for(project, root)
    sfile = pdir / "series"
    if not sfile.is_file():
        return []
    out = []
    for line in sfile.read_text(encoding="utf-8").splitlines():
        line = line.strip()
        if not line or line.startswith("#"):
            continue
        patch = pdir / line
        if not patch.is_file():
            raise SystemExit(f"ERROR: {project}: series lists missing patch {line}")
        out.append(patch)
    return out


def projects(root: Path) -> list[str]:
    out = []
    if not root.is_dir():
        return out
    for d in sorted(root.iterdir()):
        if not d.is_dir() or not (d / "series").is_file():
            continue
        project = project_for(d.name)
        if project is not None:
            out.append(project)
    return out


def git_apply(project_dir: Path, patch: Path, *, reverse: bool, check: bool) -> None:
    args = ["git", "apply", "--verbose"]
    if check:
        args.append("--check")
    if reverse:
        args.append("--reverse")
    # whitespace warnings on context lines are normal in AOSP; do not fail on them
    args += [str(patch)]
    proc = subprocess.run(args, cwd=project_dir, capture_output=True, text=True)
    if proc.returncode != 0:
        raise SystemExit(
            f"ERROR: {'reverse ' if reverse else ''}apply failed in {project_dir.name}:\n"
            f"  patch: {patch.name}\n  {proc.stderr.strip()}\n"
            "The tree does not match the pinned source revision. Fix the tree or update the\n"
            "patch set; do not ship with the feature silently missing."
        )
    if check:
        print(f"  ok    {project_dir.name}: {patch.name}")


def is_applied(project_dir: Path, patch: Path) -> bool:
    proc = subprocess.run(
        ["git", "apply", "--reverse", "--check", str(patch)],
        cwd=project_dir, capture_output=True, text=True)
    return proc.returncode == 0


def patch_paths(patch: Path) -> list[str]:
    """Every file path the patch touches, including rename/copy ends."""
    out: list[str] = []

    def add(p: str) -> None:
        p = p.split("\t")[0].strip()
        if p.startswith("a/") or p.startswith("b/"):
            p = p[2:]
        if p not in ("", "/dev/null") and p not in out:
            out.append(p)

    for line in patch.read_text(encoding="utf-8", errors="replace").splitlines():
        if line.startswith("diff --git "):
            parts = line.split()
            if len(parts) >= 4:
                add(parts[2])
                add(parts[3])
        elif line.startswith("--- ") or line.startswith("+++ "):
            add(line[4:])
        elif line.startswith(("rename from ", "rename to ",
                              "copy from ", "copy to ")):
            add(line.split(" ", 2)[2])
    return out


def series_applied(project_dir: Path, patches: list[Path]) -> bool:
    """True if the whole series is applied.

    Reverse-checking one patch in isolation is not enough: a later patch can
    change the context of an earlier one, so its reverse check fails even
    though the series is fully applied. Reverse the series in reverse order in
    a throwaway copy of every touched file instead. This never writes to the
    real checkout.
    """
    if not patches:
        return True
    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="lenos-series-") as td:
        tmp = Path(td)
        for patch in patches:
            for rel in patch_paths(patch):
                src = project_dir / rel
                if not src.is_file():
                    continue
                dst = tmp / rel
                dst.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
                shutil.copy2(src, dst)
        for patch in reversed(patches):
            proc = subprocess.run(
                ["git", "apply", "--reverse", "--whitespace=nowarn", str(patch)],
                cwd=tmp, capture_output=True, text=True)
            if proc.returncode != 0:
                return False
        return True


def created_paths(patch: Path) -> list[str]:
    """Files the patch creates or renames to, as project-relative paths."""
    out: list[str] = []
    old_is_null = False
    for line in patch.read_text(encoding="utf-8").splitlines():
        if line.startswith("--- "):
            old_is_null = line[4:].split("\t")[0].strip() == "/dev/null"
        elif line.startswith("+++ "):
            p = line[4:].split("\t")[0].strip()
            if old_is_null and p not in ("", "/dev/null"):
                out.append(p[2:] if p.startswith("b/") else p)
            old_is_null = False
        elif line.startswith(("rename to ", "copy to ")):
            p = line.split(" to ", 1)[1].strip()
            if p not in ("", "/dev/null"):
                out.append(p[2:] if p.startswith("b/") else p)
    return out


def reset_project(project: str, pdir: Path, patches: list[Path]) -> None:
    """Restore the pinned state: checkout tracked files, remove created files."""
    dirty = subprocess.run(["git", "status", "--porcelain", "--untracked-files=no"],
                           cwd=pdir, capture_output=True, text=True).stdout
    if dirty.strip():
        print(f"  WARNING {project}: discarding tracked edits:")
        for line in dirty.splitlines():
            print(f"    {line}")

    proc = subprocess.run(["git", "checkout", "--", "."],
                          cwd=pdir, capture_output=True, text=True)
    if proc.returncode != 0:
        raise SystemExit(f"ERROR: git checkout failed in {pdir}:\n{proc.stderr.strip()}")

    for patch in patches:
        for rel in created_paths(patch):
            f = pdir / rel
            if not f.exists():
                continue
            tracked = subprocess.run(["git", "ls-files", "--error-unmatch", rel],
                                     cwd=pdir, capture_output=True, text=True)
            if tracked.returncode == 0:
                raise SystemExit(
                    f"ERROR: {project}: series creates {rel} but it is tracked.\n"
                    "The patch set does not match the pinned revision; do not reset blindly.")
            f.unlink()
            print(f"  removed {project}: {rel}")
            parent = f.parent
            while parent != pdir and parent.is_dir():
                try:
                    parent.rmdir()
                except OSError:
                    break
                parent = parent.parent

    status = subprocess.run(["git", "status", "--porcelain", "--untracked-files=no"],
                            cwd=pdir, capture_output=True, text=True)
    if status.stdout.strip():
        raise SystemExit(
            f"ERROR: {project}: still modified after reset:\n{status.stdout.strip()}")
    print(f"  reset {project}: pinned state")


def main() -> int:
    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    ap.add_argument("--tree", help="LineageOS source tree root")
    ap.add_argument("--project", action="append", default=[],
                    help="limit to this project path (repeatable)")
    ap.add_argument("--check", action="store_true", help="verify patches apply, do not write")
    ap.add_argument("--apply", action="store_true", help="apply patches")
    ap.add_argument("--reverse", action="store_true", help="reverse direction")
    ap.add_argument("--list", action="store_true", help="list project/patch pairs")
    ap.add_argument("--status", action="store_true",
                    help="report applied/not applied per patch (needs --tree)")
    ap.add_argument("--require-applied", action="store_true",
                    help="exit non-zero unless the whole series is applied (needs --tree)")
    ap.add_argument("--reset", action="store_true",
                    help="restore the series' projects to the pinned revision "
                         "(git checkout + remove files the series created)")
    ap.add_argument("--experimental", action="store_true",
                    help="use patches-experimental/ (apply only after the stable series)")
    args = ap.parse_args()

    root = patch_root_for(args.experimental)

    if args.list:
        for project in projects(root):
            if args.project and project not in args.project:
                continue
            for patch in series(project, root):
                print(f"{project}\t{patch.name}")
        return 0

    actions = (args.apply, args.check, args.status,
               args.require_applied, args.reset)
    if sum(bool(a) for a in actions) != 1:
        ap.error("choose exactly one of --check/--apply/--status/"
                 "--require-applied/--reset")
    if args.reverse and not (args.apply or args.check):
        ap.error("--reverse is a modifier for --check or --apply")

    if not args.tree:
        ap.error("--tree is required unless --list")
    tree = Path(args.tree).resolve()

    targets = args.project or projects(root)
    if not targets:
        raise SystemExit("ERROR: no projects with a series file found in " + str(root))

    rc = 0
    for project in targets:
        patches = series(project, root)
        if not patches:
            print(f"  skip  {project}: no patches")
            continue
        pdir = tree / project
        if not (pdir / ".git").exists() and not (pdir / ".git").is_file():
            print(f"  WARN  {project}: not a git checkout under {tree}; skipping")
            rc = 1
            continue
        if args.reset:
            reset_project(project, pdir, patches)
            continue
        if args.require_applied:
            if series_applied(pdir, patches):
                print(f"  applied series {project}: {len(patches)} patches")
            else:
                print(f"  NOT applied  {project}: series is missing or partial")
                rc = 1
            continue
        applied_flags = [is_applied(pdir, patch) for patch in patches]
        if not all(applied_flags) and series_applied(pdir, patches):
            # An earlier patch may no longer reverse on its own after a later
            # patch in the same file. The whole-series check is authoritative.
            applied_flags = [True] * len(patches)
        for patch, applied in zip(patches, applied_flags):
            if args.status:
                state = "applied" if applied else "missing"
                print(f"  {state:7} {project}: {patch.name}")
                continue
            if args.reverse:
                if not applied:
                    print(f"  skip(reverse) {project}: {patch.name} (not applied)")
                    continue
                git_apply(pdir, patch, reverse=True, check=args.check)
                if not args.check:
                    print(f"  reversed {project}: {patch.name}")
                continue
            if applied:
                print(f"  skip  {project}: {patch.name} (already applied)")
                continue
            git_apply(pdir, patch, reverse=False, check=args.check)
            if args.check:
                continue
            print(f"  applied {project}: {patch.name}")
    return rc


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main())

"""Project path <-> patch directory mapping shared by the lenOS tools.

Everything under ``vendor/lenos/patches/<alias>/`` holds one project's patch
series. The alias is the project path with ``/`` replaced by ``_`` for most
projects; projects whose name contains a dash get an explicit alias so that
the directory name is a valid Python/Bash identifier-ish token.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

PROJECT_ALIASES = {
    "bionic": "bionic",
    "frameworks/base": "frameworks_base",
    "frameworks/native": "frameworks_native",
    "frameworks/opt/telephony": "frameworks_opt_telephony",
    "packages/apps/Settings": "packages_apps_Settings",
    "packages/apps/Updater": "packages_apps_Updater",
    "packages/apps/LineageParts": "packages_apps_LineageParts",
    "packages/apps/CellBroadcastReceiver": "packages_apps_CellBroadcastReceiver",
    "packages/apps/SetupWizard": "packages_apps_SetupWizard",
    "packages/apps/Seedvault": "packages_apps_Seedvault",
    "packages/modules/Connectivity": "packages_modules_Connectivity",
    "packages/modules/Permission": "packages_modules_Permission",
    "packages/modules/Wifi": "packages_modules_Wifi",
    "packages/modules/NetworkStack": "packages_modules_NetworkStack",
    "packages/providers/MediaProvider": "packages_providers_MediaProvider",
    "system/netd": "system_netd",
    "system/vold": "system_vold",
    "system/core": "system_core",
    "system/ca-certificates": "system_ca-certificates",
    "system/extras": "system_extras",
    "packages/services/Telephony": "packages_services_Telephony",
    "lineage-sdk": "lineage_sdk",
    "vendor/lineage": "vendor_lineage",
    "device/nothing/asteroids": "device_nothing_asteroids",
    "kernel/nothing/sm7635": "kernel_nothing_sm7635",
}


def alias_for(project: str) -> str:
    return PROJECT_ALIASES.get(project, project.replace("/", "_"))


def project_for(alias: str) -> str | None:
    for project, candidate in PROJECT_ALIASES.items():
        if candidate == alias:
            return project
    return None
